name: A367400.g_pascal
statement: lemma g_pascal (f p k : ℕ) : g (f + 1) p (k + 1) = g f p (k + 1) + g f p k
proof:
:= by
  unfold g
  rw [Finset.sum_range_succ _ (k + 1), Finset.sum_range_succ _ (k + 1)]
  have h : ∀ j ∈ range (k + 1),
      p.choose j * 2 ^ j * (f + 1).choose (k + 1 - j)
        = p.choose j * 2 ^ j * f.choose (k + 1 - j) + p.choose j * 2 ^ j * f.choose (k - j) := by
    intro j hj
    have hj' : j < k + 1 := mem_range.mp hj
    have e : k + 1 - j = (k - j) + 1 := by omega
    rw [e, Nat.choose_succ_succ]
    ring
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl h, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  simp only [Nat.sub_self, Nat.choose_zero_right]
  ring

name: A367400.g_eq_zero
statement: lemma g_eq_zero (f p k : ℕ) (h : f + p < k) : g f p k = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold g
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro j _
  by_cases hj : p < j
  · rw [Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt hj]
    simp
  · rw [Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt (show f < k - j by omega)]
    simp

name: A367400.T_pascal
statement: lemma T_pascal (s n : ℕ) : T (s + 1) (n + 1) = T (s + 1) n + T s n
proof:
:= by
  unfold T
  have h0 : g (n + 1 - 2 * (n + 1)) (n + 1) (2 * (n + 1) + (s + 1)) = 0 :=
    g_eq_zero _ _ _ (by omega)
  rw [Finset.sum_range_succ _ (n + 1), h0, add_zero, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro p hp
  have hp' : p < n + 1 := mem_range.mp hp
  by_cases h : 2 * p ≤ n
  · have e : n + 1 - 2 * p = (n - 2 * p) + 1 := by omega
    rw [e, ← add_assoc, g_pascal]
  · have h1 : g (n + 1 - 2 * p) p (2 * p + (s + 1)) = 0 := g_eq_zero _ _ _ (by omega)
    have h2 : g (n - 2 * p) p (2 * p + (s + 1)) = 0 := g_eq_zero _ _ _ (by omega)
    have h3 : g (n - 2 * p) p (2 * p + s) = 0 := g_eq_zero _ _ _ (by omega)
    rw [h1, h2, h3]

name: A367400.T_step
statement:
lemma T_step (s n : ℕ) :
    T s (n + 2) = (n + 2).choose s + T (s + 2) n + 2 * T (s + 1) n
proof:
:= by
  show ∑ p ∈ range (n + 1 + 1 + 1), g (n + 2 - 2 * p) p (2 * p + s)
    = (n + 2).choose s + ∑ p ∈ range (n + 1), g (n - 2 * p) p (2 * p + (s + 2))
      + 2 * ∑ p ∈ range (n + 1), g (n - 2 * p) p (2 * p + (s + 1))
  rw [Finset.sum_range_succ' _ (n + 1 + 1), Finset.sum_range_succ _ (n + 1)]
  have hz : g (n + 2 - 2 * (n + 1 + 1)) (n + 1 + 1) (2 * (n + 1 + 1) + s) = 0 :=
    g_eq_zero _ _ _ (by omega)
  have h0 : g (n + 2 - 2 * 0) 0 (2 * 0 + s) = (n + 2).choose s := by
    rw [g_zero_pairs]
    simp
  have h : ∀ p ∈ range (n + 1), g (n + 2 - 2 * (p + 1)) (p + 1) (2 * (p + 1) + s)
      = g (n - 2 * p) p (2 * p + (s + 2)) + 2 * g (n - 2 * p) p (2 * p + (s + 1)) := by
    intro p _
    have e1 : n + 2 - 2 * (p + 1) = n - 2 * p := by omega
    have e2 : 2 * (p + 1) + s = (2 * p + (s + 1)) + 1 := by omega
    have e3 : 2 * p + (s + 2) = (2 * p + (s + 1)) + 1 := by omega
    rw [e1, e2, e3, g_succ]
  rw [hz, h0, Finset.sum_congr rfl h, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum]
  ring

name: A367400.hk_odd

name: A367400.sum_range_pairs
statement:
lemma sum_range_pairs (h : ℕ → ℕ) (m : ℕ) :
    ∑ k ∈ range (2 * m + 1), h k = h 0 + ∑ p ∈ range m, (h (2 * p + 1) + h (2 * p + 2))
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp
  | succ m ih =>
    have e : 2 * (m + 1) + 1 = (2 * m + 1) + 1 + 1 := by ring
    rw [e, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ, ih, Finset.sum_range_succ]
    have e2 : 2 * m + 1 + 1 = 2 * m + 2 := rfl
    rw [e2]
    ring

name: A367400.formula_eq
statement: theorem formula_eq (n : ℕ) : formula n = 1 + T 1 n + T 2 n
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : formula n = ∑ k ∈ range (n + 1), hk n k := rfl
  have h2 : ∑ k ∈ range (n + 1), hk n k = ∑ k ∈ range (2 * (n + 1) + 1), hk n k := by
    apply Finset.sum_subset
    · intro k hk'
      rw [mem_range] at *
      omega
    · intro k _ hk'
      rw [mem_range] at hk'
      exact hk_eq_zero n k (by omega)
  rw [h1, h2, sum_range_pairs, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  simp only [hk_zero, hk_odd, hk_even, T]
  ring

name: A367400.formula_recurrence
statement:
theorem formula_recurrence (n : ℕ) :
    formula (n + 4) + formula (n + 2) + formula n = 2 * formula (n + 3) + 2 * formula (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have f0 := formula_eq n
  have f1 := formula_eq (n + 1)
  have f2 := formula_eq (n + 2)
  have f3 := formula_eq (n + 3)
  have f4 := formula_eq (n + 4)
  have v0 : T 2 (n + 1) = T 2 n + T 1 n := T_pascal 1 n
  have v1 : T 2 (n + 2) = T 2 (n + 1) + T 1 (n + 1) := T_pascal 1 (n + 1)
  have v2 : T 2 (n + 3) = T 2 (n + 2) + T 1 (n + 2) := T_pascal 1 (n + 2)
  have v3 : T 2 (n + 4) = T 2 (n + 3) + T 1 (n + 3) := T_pascal 1 (n + 3)
  have w0 : T 3 (n + 1) = T 3 n + T 2 n := T_pascal 2 n
  have w1 : T 3 (n + 2) = T 3 (n + 1) + T 2 (n + 1) := T_pascal 2 (n + 1)
  have u0 : T 1 (n + 2) = n + 2 + T 3 n + 2 * T 2 n := by
    have := T_step 1 n
    rw [Nat.choose_one_right] at this
    exact this
  have u1 : T 1 (n + 3) = n + 3 + T 3 (n + 1) + 2 * T 2 (n + 1) := by
    have := T_step 1 (n + 1)
    rw [Nat.choose_one_right] at this
    exact this
  have u2 : T 1 (n + 4) = n + 4 + T 3 (n + 2) + 2 * T 2 (n + 2) := by
    have := T_step 1 (n + 2)
    rw [Nat.choose_one_right] at this
    exact this
  omega

name: A367400.a_succ
statement: theorem a_succ (n : ℕ) : a (n + 1) = a n + aTop (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  unfold a aTop
  have h := card_filter_add_card_filter_not
    (s := (Icc 1 (n + 1)).powerset.filter
      (fun S => ¬ ∃ x ∈ S, ∃ y ∈ S, x ≠ y ∧ x + y = S.card))
    (fun S : Finset ℕ => n + 1 ∈ S)
  have e1 : ((Icc 1 (n + 1)).powerset.filter
        (fun S => ¬ ∃ x ∈ S, ∃ y ∈ S, x ≠ y ∧ x + y = S.card)).filter
        (fun S : Finset ℕ => n + 1 ∈ S)
      = (Icc 1 (n + 1)).powerset.filter
        (fun S => n + 1 ∈ S ∧ ¬ ∃ x ∈ S, ∃ y ∈ S, x ≠ y ∧ x + y = S.card) := by
    ext S
    simp only [mem_filter]
    tauto
  have e2 : ((Icc 1 (n + 1)).powerset.filter
        (fun S => ¬ ∃ x ∈ S, ∃ y ∈ S, x ≠ y ∧ x + y = S.card)).filter
        (fun S : Finset ℕ => ¬ n + 1 ∈ S)
      = (Icc 1 n).powerset.filter
        (fun S => ¬ ∃ x ∈ S, ∃ y ∈ S, x ≠ y ∧ x + y = S.card) := by
    ext S
    simp only [mem_filter, mem_powerset]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨hS, hP⟩, hn⟩
      refine ⟨fun x hx => ?_, hP⟩
      have hx' := hS hx
      have hne : x ≠ n + 1 := fun h => hn (h ▸ hx)
      rw [mem_Icc] at hx' ⊢
      omega
    · rintro ⟨hS, hP⟩
      refine ⟨⟨fun x hx => ?_, hP⟩, fun hn => ?_⟩
      · have hx' := hS hx
        rw [mem_Icc] at hx' ⊢
        omega
      · have hn' := hS hn
        rw [mem_Icc] at hn'
        omega
  rw [e1, e2] at h
  omega

name: A367400.aTop_recurrence
statement:
theorem aTop_recurrence (n : ℕ) :
    aTop (n + 4) + aTop (n + 2) + aTop n = 2 * aTop (n + 3) + 2 * aTop (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero => decide
  | succ m =>
    have s0 : a (m + 1) = a m + aTop (m + 1) := a_succ m
    have s1 : a (m + 2) = a (m + 1) + aTop (m + 1 + 1) := a_succ (m + 1)
    have s2 : a (m + 3) = a (m + 2) + aTop (m + 1 + 2) := a_succ (m + 2)
    have s3 : a (m + 4) = a (m + 3) + aTop (m + 1 + 3) := a_succ (m + 3)
    have s4 : a (m + 5) = a (m + 4) + aTop (m + 1 + 4) := a_succ (m + 4)
    have r0 : a (m + 4) + a (m + 2) + a m = 2 * a (m + 3) + 2 * a (m + 1) := a_recurrence m
    have r1 : a (m + 5) + a (m + 3) + a (m + 1) = 2 * a (m + 4) + 2 * a (m + 2) :=
      a_recurrence (m + 1)
    omega

name: A347722.a_eq_add
statement:
theorem a_eq_add (n : ℕ) :
    a n = ((verts n).powerset.filter fun S => Star S ∧ Unc S).card
        + ((verts n).powerset.filter PM).card
proof:
:= by
  unfold a
  rw [← Finset.card_union_of_disjoint]
  · congr 1
    ext S
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_powerset]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hS, hI⟩
      rcases (irredundant_iff S hS).mp hI with h | h
      · exact Or.inl ⟨hS, h⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨hS, h⟩
    · rintro (⟨hS, h⟩ | ⟨hS, h⟩)
      · exact ⟨hS, (irredundant_iff S hS).mpr (Or.inl h)⟩
      · exact ⟨hS, (irredundant_iff S hS).mpr (Or.inr h)⟩
  · rw [Finset.disjoint_filter]
    rintro S _ ⟨_, v, hv⟩ hPM
    have := hPM v
    omega

name: A347722.card_starUnc
statement:
theorem card_starUnc (n : ℕ) :
    ((verts n).powerset.filter fun S => Star S ∧ Unc S).card
      = (Finset.univ.filter fun g : Fin n → Fin n => Good g ∧ ∃ v, IsoAt g v).card
proof:
:= by
  symm
  apply Finset.card_bij (fun g _ => edgeSet g)
  · intro g hg
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hg
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_powerset]
    exact ⟨edgeSet_subset g, star_edgeSet g hg.1.1, (unc_edgeSet_iff g hg.1.1).mpr hg.2⟩
  · intro g₁ h₁ g₂ h₂ h
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at h₁ h₂
    exact edgeSet_injective g₁ g₂ h₁.1 h₂.1 h
  · intro S hS
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_powerset] at hS
    obtain ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩ := exists_good_of_star S hS.1 hS.2.1
    refine ⟨g, ?_, rfl⟩
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    exact ⟨hg, (unc_edgeSet_iff g hg.1).mp hS.2.2⟩

name: A347722.D_self
statement:
theorem D_self (n : ℕ) :
    D n n = (Finset.univ.filter fun g : Fin n → Fin n => Good g).card
proof:
:= by
  unfold D Good
  refine congrArg Finset.card (Finset.filter_congr fun g _ => ?_)
  exact and_congr_right fun _ => forall_congr' fun v => imp_iff_right v.isLt

theorem F_self (n : ℕ) :

proof:

  unfold F
  refine congrArg Finset.card (Finset.filter_congr fun g _ => ?_)
  refine and_congr_right fun _ => ?_
  rw [not_exists]
  exact forall_congr' fun v => imp_iff_right v.isLt

name: A347722.card_good_iso_add
statement:
theorem card_good_iso_add (n : ℕ) :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun g : Fin n → Fin n => Good g ∧ ∃ v, IsoAt g v).card + F n n
      = D n n
proof:
:= by

name: A347722.a_eq_formula
statement: theorem a_eq_formula (n : ℕ) : (a n : ℤ) = formula n
proof:
:= by
  have h3 : ((Finset.univ.filter fun g : Fin n → Fin n => Good g ∧ ∃ v, IsoAt g v).card : ℤ)
      = (D n n : ℤ) - (F n n : ℤ) := by
    have := congrArg (Nat.cast : ℕ → ℤ) (card_good_iso_add n)
    push_cast at this
    omega
  unfold formula
  rw [← diff_eq_sum D F D_zero D_succ F_zero F_succ n, a_eq_add, card_starUnc, card_pms,
    Nat.cast_add, h3]
  split_ifs
  · ring
  · rw [Nat.cast_zero]
    ring

name: A307917.sum_card_dirPaths
statement:
theorem sum_card_dirPaths (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ L ∈ Finset.Icc 2 (2 * n), (dirPaths n L).card
      = 2 * ∑ L ∈ Finset.Icc 2 (2 * n), B n L (L - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun L hL => ?_
  have h2 := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hL).1
  exact card_dirPaths n L (by omega)

name: A307917.a_eq_sum

proof:

name: A048248.mem_traces_iff
statement:
theorem mem_traces_iff (n : ℕ) (l : List ℕ) :
    l ∈ ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n → Bool)).image fun f => trace n (List.ofFn f))
      ↔ Valid n l
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.mem_image]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨f, -, rfl⟩
    exact trace_valid n (List.ofFn f) (by simp)
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := exists_walk_of_valid n l h
    subst hw
    exact ⟨fun i => w.get i, Finset.mem_univ _, by rw [List.ofFn_get]⟩

name: A367400.g_succ
statement: lemma g_succ (f p k : ℕ) : g f (p + 1) (k + 1) = g f p (k + 1) + 2 * g f p k
proof:
:= by
  unfold g
  rw [Finset.sum_range_succ' _ (k + 1), Finset.sum_range_succ' _ (k + 1), Finset.mul_sum]
  have h : ∀ j ∈ range (k + 1),
      (p + 1).choose (j + 1) * 2 ^ (j + 1) * f.choose (k + 1 - (j + 1))
        = p.choose (j + 1) * 2 ^ (j + 1) * f.choose (k + 1 - (j + 1))
          + 2 * (p.choose j * 2 ^ j * f.choose (k - j)) := by
    intro j _
    rw [Nat.choose_succ_succ', Nat.add_sub_add_right]
    ring
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl h, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  simp only [Nat.choose_zero_right]
  ring

name: A367400.card_at_most_one_per_pair
statement:
lemma card_at_most_one_per_pair {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (F : Finset α) (σ : α → α)
    (L : Finset α) :
    (∀ x ∈ L, x ∉ F) → (∀ x ∈ L, σ x ∉ F) → (∀ x ∈ L, ∀ y ∈ L, σ x ≠ y) →
    (∀ x ∈ L, ∀ y ∈ L, σ x = σ y → x = y) →
    ∀ k, ((F ∪ L ∪ L.image σ).powerset.filter
        (fun S => S.card = k ∧ ∀ x ∈ L, x ∈ S → σ x ∉ S)).card = g F.card L.card k
proof:
:= by
  induction L using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
    intro _ _ _ _ k
    simp only [union_empty, image_empty, notMem_empty, false_imp_iff, implies_true, and_true,
      card_empty, g_zero_pairs]
    rw [← Finset.powersetCard_eq_filter, Finset.card_powersetCard]
  | insert a L' ha ih =>
    intro hF hσF hLσ hinj k
    have haL : a ∈ insert a L' := mem_insert_self _ _
    have ih' := ih (fun x hx => hF x (mem_insert_of_mem hx))
      (fun x hx => hσF x (mem_insert_of_mem hx))
      (fun x hx y hy => hLσ x (mem_insert_of_mem hx) y (mem_insert_of_mem hy))
      (fun x hx y hy => hinj x (mem_insert_of_mem hx) y (mem_insert_of_mem hy))
    
    have haσa : σ a ≠ a := hLσ a haL a haL
    have haG : a ∉ F ∪ L' ∪ L'.image σ := by
      simp only [mem_union, mem_image, not_or, not_exists, not_and]
      exact ⟨⟨hF a haL, ha⟩, fun x hx h => hLσ x (mem_insert_of_mem hx) a haL h⟩
    have hσaG : σ a ∉ F ∪ L' ∪ L'.image σ := by
      simp only [mem_union, mem_image, not_or, not_exists, not_and]
      refine ⟨⟨hσF a haL, fun h => hLσ a haL (σ a) (mem_insert_of_mem h) rfl⟩, fun x hx h => ?_⟩
      have hxa := hinj x (mem_insert_of_mem hx) a haL h
      exact ha (hxa ▸ hx)
    have hG : F ∪ insert a L' ∪ (insert a L').image σ
        = insert a (insert (σ a) (F ∪ L' ∪ L'.image σ)) := by
      ext z
      simp only [mem_union, mem_insert, mem_image, image_insert]
      tauto
    generalize F ∪ L' ∪ L'.image σ = G' at ih' haG hσaG hG
    have haG2 : a ∉ insert (σ a) G' := by
      simp only [mem_insert, not_or]
      exact ⟨fun h => haσa h.symm, haG⟩
    
    have key1 : ∀ T ∈ G'.powerset,
        ((∀ x ∈ insert a L', x ∈ T → σ x ∉ T) ↔ (∀ x ∈ L', x ∈ T → σ x ∉ T)) := by
      intro T hT
      have hTG := mem_powerset.mp hT
      constructor
      · intro h x hx hxT
        exact h x (mem_insert_of_mem hx) hxT
      · intro h x hx hxT
        rcases mem_insert.mp hx with rfl | hx'
        · exact absurd (hTG hxT) haG
        · exact h x hx' hxT
    have key2 : ∀ T ∈ G'.powerset,
        ((∀ x ∈ insert a L', x ∈ insert (σ a) T → σ x ∉ insert (σ a) T)
          ↔ (∀ x ∈ L', x ∈ T → σ x ∉ T)) := by
      intro T hT
      have hTG := mem_powerset.mp hT
      constructor
      · intro h x hx hxT hσx
        exact h x (mem_insert_of_mem hx) (mem_insert_of_mem hxT) (mem_insert_of_mem hσx)
      · intro h x hx hxT hσx
        rcases mem_insert.mp hx with rfl | hx'
        · rcases mem_insert.mp hxT with h1 | h1
          · exact haσa h1.symm
          · exact haG (hTG h1)
        · rcases mem_insert.mp hxT with h1 | h1
          · exact hLσ a haL x hx h1.symm
          · rcases mem_insert.mp hσx with h2 | h2
            · have hxa := hinj x hx a haL h2
              exact ha (hxa ▸ hx')
            · exact h x hx' h1 h2
    have key3 : ∀ T ∈ G'.powerset,
        ((∀ x ∈ insert a L', x ∈ insert a T → σ x ∉ insert a T)
          ↔ (∀ x ∈ L', x ∈ T → σ x ∉ T)) := by
      intro T hT
      have hTG := mem_powerset.mp hT
      constructor
      · intro h x hx hxT hσx
        exact h x (mem_insert_of_mem hx) (mem_insert_of_mem hxT) (mem_insert_of_mem hσx)
      · intro h x hx hxT hσx
        rcases mem_insert.mp hx with rfl | hx'
        · rcases mem_insert.mp hσx with h2 | h2
          · exact haσa h2
          · exact hσaG (hTG h2)
        · rcases mem_insert.mp hxT with h1 | h1
          · exact ha (h1 ▸ hx')
          · rcases mem_insert.mp hσx with h2 | h2
            · exact hLσ x hx a haL h2
            · exact h x hx' h1 h2
    have key4 : ∀ T ∈ G'.powerset,
        ¬ (∀ x ∈ insert a L', x ∈ insert a (insert (σ a) T) →
            σ x ∉ insert a (insert (σ a) T)) := by
      intro T _ h
      exact h a haL (mem_insert_self _ _) (mem_insert_of_mem (mem_insert_self _ _))
    have card2 : ∀ T ∈ G'.powerset, (insert (σ a) T).card = T.card + 1 := by
      intro T hT
      exact card_insert_of_notMem (fun h => hσaG (mem_powerset.mp hT h))
    have card3 : ∀ T ∈ G'.powerset, (insert a T).card = T.card + 1 := by
      intro T hT
      exact card_insert_of_notMem (fun h => haG (mem_powerset.mp hT h))
    
    simp only [Finset.card_filter] at ih' ⊢
    rw [hG, Finset.sum_powerset_insert haG2, Finset.sum_powerset_insert hσaG,
      Finset.sum_powerset_insert hσaG]
    have s1 : ∑ T ∈ G'.powerset,
        (if T.card = k ∧ ∀ x ∈ insert a L', x ∈ T → σ x ∉ T then 1 else 0)
        = g F.card L'.card k := by
      rw [← ih' k]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun T hT => if_congr (and_congr Iff.rfl (key1 T hT)) rfl rfl
    have s2 : ∑ T ∈ G'.powerset,
        (if (insert (σ a) T).card = k ∧
            ∀ x ∈ insert a L', x ∈ insert (σ a) T → σ x ∉ insert (σ a) T then 1 else 0)
        = ∑ T ∈ G'.powerset,
            (if T.card + 1 = k ∧ ∀ x ∈ L', x ∈ T → σ x ∉ T then 1 else 0) :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl fun T hT =>
        if_congr (and_congr (by rw [card2 T hT]) (key2 T hT)) rfl rfl
    have s3 : ∑ T ∈ G'.powerset,
        (if (insert a T).card = k ∧
            ∀ x ∈ insert a L', x ∈ insert a T → σ x ∉ insert a T then 1 else 0)
        = ∑ T ∈ G'.powerset,
            (if T.card + 1 = k ∧ ∀ x ∈ L', x ∈ T → σ x ∉ T then 1 else 0) :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl fun T hT =>
        if_congr (and_congr (by rw [card3 T hT]) (key3 T hT)) rfl rfl
    have s4 : ∑ T ∈ G'.powerset,
        (if (insert a (insert (σ a) T)).card = k ∧
            ∀ x ∈ insert a L', x ∈ insert a (insert (σ a) T) →
              σ x ∉ insert a (insert (σ a) T) then 1 else 0) = 0 :=
      Finset.sum_eq_zero fun T hT => if_neg fun h => key4 T hT h.2
    rw [s1, s2, s3, s4, card_insert_of_notMem ha]
    cases k with
    | zero =>
      have z : ∑ T ∈ G'.powerset,
          (if T.card + 1 = 0 ∧ ∀ x ∈ L', x ∈ T → σ x ∉ T then 1 else 0) = 0 :=
        Finset.sum_eq_zero fun T _ => if_neg fun h => Nat.succ_ne_zero _ h.1
      simp only [z, g_zero_size, add_zero]
    | succ k' =>
      have z : ∑ T ∈ G'.powerset,
          (if T.card + 1 = k' + 1 ∧ ∀ x ∈ L', x ∈ T → σ x ∉ T then 1 else 0)
          = g F.card L'.card k' := by
        rw [← ih' k']
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun T _ =>
          if_congr (and_congr (by omega) Iff.rfl) rfl rfl
      rw [z, g_succ F.card L'.card k']
      ring

name: A367400.card_fixed_size
statement:
lemma card_fixed_size (n k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) :
    ((Icc 1 n).powerset.filter
        (fun S => S.card = k ∧ ¬ ∃ x ∈ S, ∃ y ∈ S, x ≠ y ∧ x + y = k)).card
      = g (n - 2 * ((k - 1) / 2)) ((k - 1) / 2) k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ : ∃ p, p = (k - 1) / 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hp]
  have hsub : Icc 1 p ∪ (Icc 1 p).image (fun x => k - x) ⊆ Icc 1 n := by
    intro z hz
    simp only [mem_union, mem_Icc, mem_image] at hz ⊢
    rcases hz with h | ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ <;> omega
  have hdisj : Disjoint (Icc 1 p) ((Icc 1 p).image (fun x => k - x)) := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
    intro z hz hz'
    simp only [mem_Icc, mem_image] at hz hz'
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hz'
    omega
  have hinj : Set.InjOn (fun x => k - x) (Icc 1 p : Finset ℕ) := by
    intro x hx y hy hxy
    rw [mem_coe, mem_Icc] at hx hy
    have hxy' : k - x = k - y := hxy
    omega
  have hcardF : (Icc 1 n \ (Icc 1 p ∪ (Icc 1 p).image (fun x => k - x))).card = n - 2 * p := by
    rw [card_sdiff_of_subset hsub, card_union_of_disjoint hdisj, card_image_of_injOn hinj,
      Nat.card_Icc, Nat.card_Icc]
    omega
  have hG : Icc 1 n \ (Icc 1 p ∪ (Icc 1 p).image (fun x => k - x)) ∪ Icc 1 p
      ∪ (Icc 1 p).image (fun x => k - x) = Icc 1 n := by
    rw [union_assoc, sdiff_union_of_subset hsub]
  have main := card_at_most_one_per_pair
    (Icc 1 n \ (Icc 1 p ∪ (Icc 1 p).image (fun x => k - x))) (fun x => k - x) (Icc 1 p)
    (by
      intro x hx hxF
      exact (mem_sdiff.mp hxF).2 (mem_union_left _ hx))
    (by
      intro x hx hxF
      exact (mem_sdiff.mp hxF).2 (mem_union_right _ (mem_image_of_mem _ hx)))
    (by
      intro x hx y hy
      rw [mem_Icc] at hx hy
      show k - x ≠ y
      omega)
    (by
      intro x hx y hy hxy
      rw [mem_Icc] at hx hy
      have hxy' : k - x = k - y := hxy
      omega)
    k
  rw [hG, hcardF, Nat.card_Icc, Nat.add_sub_cancel] at main
  rw [← main]
  congr 1
  apply filter_congr
  intro S hS
  have hS1 : ∀ x ∈ S, 1 ≤ x := fun x hx => (mem_Icc.mp (mem_powerset.mp hS hx)).1
  refine and_congr Iff.rfl ⟨fun h x hx hxS hkx => h ⟨x, hxS, k - x, hkx, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · have := mem_Icc.mp hx
    omega
  · have := mem_Icc.mp hx
    omega
  · rintro h ⟨x, hx, y, hy, hne, hxy⟩
    have hx1 := hS1 x hx
    have hy1 := hS1 y hy
    rcases Nat.lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hlt | hlt
    · have e : k - x = y := by omega
      exact h x (mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hx1, by omega⟩) hx (by show k - x ∈ S; rw [e]; exact hy)
    · have e : k - y = x := by omega
      exact h y (mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hy1, by omega⟩) hy (by show k - y ∈ S; rw [e]; exact hx)

name: A367400.a_eq_formula
statement: theorem a_eq_formula (n : ℕ) : a n = formula n
proof:
:= by
  unfold a formula
  have hmaps : Set.MapsTo Finset.card
      (((Icc 1 n).powerset.filter
        (fun S => ¬ ∃ x ∈ S, ∃ y ∈ S, x ≠ y ∧ x + y = S.card) : Finset (Finset ℕ)) :
          Set (Finset ℕ))
      ((range (n + 1) : Finset ℕ) : Set ℕ) := by
    intro S hS
    have h := card_le_card (mem_powerset.mp (mem_filter.mp (mem_coe.mp hS)).1)
    rw [Nat.card_Icc] at h
    exact mem_coe.mpr (mem_range.mpr (by omega))
  rw [card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise hmaps]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun k hk => ?_
  have hk' : k ≤ n := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (mem_range.mp hk)
  have h := card_fixed_size n k hk'
  unfold g at h
  rw [← h, filter_filter]
  congr 1
  apply filter_congr
  intro S _
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    rw [h2] at h1
    exact ⟨h2, h1⟩
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    rw [← h1] at h2
    exact ⟨h2, h1⟩

name: A367400.formula_eq_sum_to_p
statement:
theorem formula_eq_sum_to_p (n : ℕ) :
    formula n = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ∑ j ∈ Finset.range ((k - 1) / 2 + 1),
      ((k - 1) / 2).choose j * 2 ^ j * (n - 2 * ((k - 1) / 2)).choose (k - j)
proof:
:= by
  unfold formula
  refine sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
  have hle : (k - 1) / 2 + 1 ≤ k + 1 := by omega
  refine (sum_subset (range_subset_range.mpr hle) fun j _ hj => ?_).symm
  have hj' : (k - 1) / 2 < j := by
    simp only [mem_range, not_lt] at hj
    omega
  rw [Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt hj']
  simp

name: A361622.mem_pts
statement:
theorem mem_pts {n : ℕ} {x y : ℤ} :
    (x, y) ∈ pts n ↔ -(n : ℤ) ≤ x ∧ x ≤ n ∧ -(n : ℤ) ≤ y ∧ y ≤ n ∧ (x = 0 ∨ y = 0)

name: A361622.mem_armE
statement:
theorem mem_armE {n : ℕ} {x y : ℤ} :

name: A361622.pts_eq
statement:
theorem pts_eq (n : ℕ) :
    pts n = insert ((0 : ℤ), (0 : ℤ)) ((armE n ∪ armW n) ∪ (armN n ∪ armS n))
proof:
:= by
  ext ⟨x, y⟩
  simp only [mem_pts, mem_insert, mem_union, mem_armE, mem_armW, mem_armN, mem_armS,
    Prod.mk.injEq]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5⟩
    by_cases hy : y = 0
    · rcases lt_trichotomy x 0 with hx | hx | hx
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨(-x).toNat, by omega⟩))
      · exact Or.inl ⟨hx, hy⟩
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨x.toNat, by omega⟩))
    · have hx : x = 0 := by omega
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hy with h | h
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨(-y).toNat, by omega⟩))
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨y.toNat, by omega⟩))
  · rintro (⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | (⟨c, hc⟩ | ⟨c, hc⟩) | (⟨c, hc⟩ | ⟨c, hc⟩)) <;> omega

name: A361622.disj_EW
statement: theorem disj_EW (n : ℕ) : Disjoint (armE n) (armW n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [disjoint_left]
  rintro ⟨x, y⟩ hp hq
  rw [mem_armE] at hp
  rw [mem_armW] at hq
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hp
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hq
  omega

statement: theorem disj_NS (n : ℕ) : Disjoint (armN n) (armS n)
proof:
:= by

name: A361622.disj_EW_NS
statement: theorem disj_EW_NS (n : ℕ) : Disjoint (armE n ∪ armW n) (armN n ∪ armS n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [disjoint_left]
  rintro ⟨x, y⟩ hp hq
  simp only [mem_union, mem_armE, mem_armW, mem_armN, mem_armS] at hp hq
  rcases hp with ⟨a, ha⟩ | ⟨a, ha⟩ <;> rcases hq with ⟨b, hb⟩ | ⟨b, hb⟩ <;> omega

name: A361622.origin_notMem
statement:
theorem origin_notMem (n : ℕ) :
    ((0 : ℤ), (0 : ℤ)) ∉ (armE n ∪ armW n) ∪ (armN n ∪ armS n)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  rw [mem_union, mem_union, mem_union, mem_armE, mem_armW, mem_armN, mem_armS] at h
  rcases h with (⟨a, ha⟩ | ⟨a, ha⟩) | (⟨a, ha⟩ | ⟨a, ha⟩) <;> omega

name: A361622.sum_pts
statement:
theorem sum_pts (n : ℕ) (F : ℤ × ℤ → ℕ) :
    ∑ p ∈ pts n, F p = F (0, 0) + ∑ c ∈ Icc 1 n,
      (F ((c : ℤ), 0) + F (-(c : ℤ), 0) + F (0, (c : ℤ)) + F (0, -(c : ℤ)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [pts_eq, sum_insert (origin_notMem n), sum_union (disj_EW_NS n), sum_union (disj_EW n),
    sum_union (disj_NS n)]
  unfold armE armW armN armS
  rw [sum_image, sum_image, sum_image, sum_image]
  · simp only [sum_add_distrib]
    ring
  all_goals
    intro a _ b _ h
    have h1 := (Prod.mk.inj h).1
    have h2 := (Prod.mk.inj h).2
    omega

name: A361622.card_pts
statement: theorem card_pts (n : ℕ) : (pts n).card = 4 * n + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [card_eq_sum_ones, sum_pts]
  simp only [sum_const, Nat.card_Icc, Nat.nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
  omega

name: A361622.a_eq_sum
statement: theorem a_eq_sum (n : ℕ) : a n = ∑ p ∈ pts n, (D n p).card
proof:
:= by
  unfold a D
  rw [card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise (f := Prod.fst) (t := pts n)]
  · refine sum_congr rfl fun p hp => ?_
    rw [← card_image_of_injective (((pts n).erase p).image (sqDist p))
      (f := fun z : ℤ => (p, z)) (fun z w h => (Prod.mk.inj h).2)]
    congr 1
    ext ⟨q, z⟩
    constructor
    · intro h
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := mem_filter.mp h
      obtain ⟨⟨p1, p2⟩, h3, h4⟩ := mem_image.mp h1
      obtain ⟨h5, h6⟩ := mem_filter.mp h3
      obtain ⟨h7, h8⟩ := mem_product.mp h5
      obtain ⟨e1, e2⟩ := Prod.mk.inj h4
      have e3 : q = p := h2
      have e4 : p1 = p := e1.trans e3
      subst e3
      subst e4
      subst e2
      exact mem_image.mpr ⟨_, mem_image.mpr ⟨p2, mem_erase.mpr ⟨Ne.symm h6, h8⟩, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    · intro h
      obtain ⟨w, hw, h1⟩ := mem_image.mp h
      obtain ⟨q', hq', h2⟩ := mem_image.mp hw
      obtain ⟨hne, hq''⟩ := mem_erase.mp hq'
      obtain ⟨e1, e2⟩ := Prod.mk.inj h1
      have e3 : p = q := e1
      subst e3
      subst e2
      subst h2
      exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_image.mpr ⟨(p, q'),
        mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_product.mpr ⟨hp, hq''⟩, Ne.symm hne⟩, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨⟨p1, p2⟩, h3, h4⟩ := mem_image.mp (mem_coe.mp hx)
    subst h4
    exact mem_coe.mpr (mem_product.mp (mem_filter.mp h3).1).1

name: A361622.D_symm
statement:
theorem D_symm (n : ℕ) (σ : ℤ × ℤ → ℤ × ℤ) (hinv : ∀ q, σ (σ q) = q)
    (hmem : ∀ q, q ∈ pts n → σ q ∈ pts n) (hd : ∀ p q, sqDist (σ p) (σ q) = sqDist p q)
    (p : ℤ × ℤ) : D n (σ p) = D n p
proof:
:= by
  unfold D
  ext z
  simp only [mem_image, mem_erase]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨q, ⟨hne, hq⟩, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨σ q, ⟨fun e => hne ?_, hmem q hq⟩, ?_⟩
    · rw [← e, hinv]
    · have h := hd p (σ q)
      rw [hinv] at h
      exact h.symm
  · rintro ⟨q, ⟨hne, hq⟩, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨σ q, ⟨fun e => hne ?_, hmem q hq⟩, hd p q⟩
    rw [← hinv q, e, hinv]

name: A361622.D_negx
statement: theorem D_negx (n : ℕ) (x y : ℤ) : D n (-x, y) = D n (x, y)
proof:
:= by
  refine D_symm n (fun p => (-p.1, p.2)) ?_ ?_ ?_ (x, y)
  · rintro ⟨u, v⟩
    exact Prod.ext (neg_neg u) rfl
  · rintro ⟨u, v⟩ h
    show (-u, v) ∈ pts n
    rw [mem_pts] at h ⊢
    omega
  · rintro ⟨u, v⟩ ⟨u', v'⟩
    simp only [sqDist]
    ring

name: A361622.D_swap
statement: theorem D_swap (n : ℕ) (x y : ℤ) : D n (y, x) = D n (x, y)
proof:
:= by
  refine D_symm n (fun p => (p.2, p.1)) ?_ ?_ ?_ (x, y)
  · rintro ⟨u, v⟩
    rfl
  · rintro ⟨u, v⟩ h
    show (v, u) ∈ pts n
    rw [mem_pts] at h ⊢
    omega
  · rintro ⟨u, v⟩ ⟨u', v'⟩
    simp only [sqDist]
    ring

name: A361622.sq_inj
statement: theorem sq_inj {a b : ℕ} (h : (a : ℤ) ^ 2 = (b : ℤ) ^ 2) : a = b
proof:
:= by
  have h' : a * a = b * b := by
    zify
    linarith
  exact Nat.mul_self_inj.mp h'

name: A361622.inj_S1
statement: theorem inj_S1 : Function.Injective fun d : ℕ => (d : ℤ) ^ 2
proof: := fun _ _ h => sq_inj h

name: A361622.inj_S2
statement: theorem inj_S2 (c : ℕ) : Function.Injective fun y : ℕ => (c : ℤ) ^ 2 + (y : ℤ) ^ 2
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ h => sq_inj (add_left_cancel h)

name: A361622.D_eq
statement: theorem D_eq (n c : ℕ) (hc : c ≤ n) : D n ((c : ℤ), 0) = S1 n c ∪ S2 n c
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  simp only [D, S1, S2, mem_image, mem_erase, mem_union, mem_Icc]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨x, y⟩, ⟨hne, hq⟩, rfl⟩
    rw [mem_pts] at hq
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5⟩ := hq
    by_cases hy : y = 0
    · subst hy
      have hx : x ≠ c := fun e => hne (by rw [e])
      left
      refine ⟨((c : ℤ) - x).natAbs, ⟨by omega, by omega⟩, ?_⟩
      rw [Int.natAbs_pow_two]
      simp only [sqDist]
      ring
    · have hx : x = 0 := by omega
      subst hx
      right
      refine ⟨y.natAbs, ⟨by omega, by omega⟩, ?_⟩
      rw [Int.natAbs_pow_two]
      simp only [sqDist]
      ring
  · rintro (⟨d, ⟨hd1, hd2⟩, rfl⟩ | ⟨y, ⟨hy1, hy2⟩, rfl⟩)
    · refine ⟨((c : ℤ) - d, 0), ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · intro e
        have := (Prod.mk.inj e).1
        omega
      · rw [mem_pts]
        omega
      · simp only [sqDist]
        ring
    · refine ⟨(0, (y : ℤ)), ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · intro e
        have := (Prod.mk.inj e).2
        omega
      · rw [mem_pts]
        omega
      · simp only [sqDist]
        ring

name: A361622.card_S1
statement: theorem card_S1 (n c : ℕ) : (S1 n c).card = c + n
proof:
:= by
  unfold S1
  rw [card_image_of_injective _ inj_S1, Nat.card_Icc, Nat.add_sub_cancel]

name: A361622.card_S2
statement: theorem card_S2 (n c : ℕ) : (S2 n c).card = n
proof:
:= by
  unfold S2
  rw [card_image_of_injective _ (inj_S2 c), Nat.card_Icc, Nat.add_sub_cancel]

name: A361622.card_inter
statement: theorem card_inter (n c : ℕ) : (S1 n c ∩ S2 n c).card = r n c
proof:
:= by
  have key : S1 n c ∩ S2 n c = ((Icc 1 n).filter fun y => IsSquare (c ^ 2 + y ^ 2)).image
      (fun y : ℕ => (c : ℤ) ^ 2 + (y : ℤ) ^ 2) := by
    ext z
    simp only [S1, S2, mem_inter, mem_image, mem_filter, mem_Icc]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨d, _, hd⟩, ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩⟩
      refine ⟨y, ⟨hy, d, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
      zify
      linarith
    · rintro ⟨y, ⟨hy, d, hd⟩, rfl⟩
      have hy1 := hy.1
      have hy2 := hy.2
      have hdz : (d : ℤ) ^ 2 = (c : ℤ) ^ 2 + (y : ℤ) ^ 2 := by
        have h : ((c ^ 2 + y ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) = ((d * d : ℕ) : ℤ) := by rw [hd]
        push_cast at h
        linarith
      refine ⟨⟨d, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, hdz⟩, ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩⟩
      · rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos d with h0 | h0
        · exfalso
          subst h0
          nlinarith [Nat.mul_le_mul hy1 hy1, Nat.zero_le (c ^ 2)]
        · exact h0
      · by_contra h
        have h' : c + y + 1 ≤ d := by omega
        nlinarith [Nat.mul_le_mul h' h', Nat.zero_le (c * y)]
  unfold r
  rw [key, card_image_of_injective _ (inj_S2 c)]

name: A361622.card_D_add
statement: theorem card_D_add (n c : ℕ) (hc : c ≤ n) : (D n ((c : ℤ), 0)).card + r n c = 2 * n + c
proof:
:= by
  rw [D_eq n c hc, ← card_inter, card_union_add_card_inter, card_S1, card_S2]
  omega

name: A361622.card_D_origin
statement: theorem card_D_origin (n : ℕ) : (D n (0, 0)).card = n
proof:
:= by
  have h : D n (0, 0) = S1 n 0 ∪ S2 n 0 := D_eq n 0 (Nat.zero_le n)
  have hsub : S2 n 0 ⊆ S1 n 0 := by
    unfold S1 S2
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hz
    refine mem_image.mpr ⟨y, mem_Icc.mpr ⟨(mem_Icc.mp hy).1, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · have := (mem_Icc.mp hy).2
      omega
    · simp
  rw [h, union_eq_left.mpr hsub, card_S1]
  omega

name: A361622.P_eq_sum
statement: theorem P_eq_sum (n : ℕ) : P n = ∑ c ∈ Icc 1 n, r n c
proof:
:= by
  simp only [P, r, card_filter, sum_product]

name: A361622.gauss
statement: theorem gauss (n : ℕ) : 2 * ∑ c ∈ Icc 1 n, c = n * (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega), mul_add, ih]
    ring

name: A361622.a_add_four_P
statement: theorem a_add_four_P (n : ℕ) : a n + 4 * P n = 10 * n ^ 2 + 3 * n
proof:
:= by
  have hS : ∑ c ∈ Icc 1 n, ((D n ((c : ℤ), 0)).card + r n c) = ∑ c ∈ Icc 1 n, (2 * n + c) :=
    sum_congr rfl fun c hc => card_D_add n c (mem_Icc.mp hc).2
  have hR : ∑ c ∈ Icc 1 n, (2 * n + c) = n * (2 * n) + ∑ c ∈ Icc 1 n, c := by
    rw [sum_add_distrib, sum_const, Nat.card_Icc, Nat.nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
  rw [sum_add_distrib] at hS
  have hG := gauss n
  have hP := P_eq_sum n
  have ha : a n = n + 4 * ∑ c ∈ Icc 1 n, (D n ((c : ℤ), 0)).card := by
    rw [a_eq_sum, sum_pts, card_D_origin, mul_sum]
    congr 1
    refine sum_congr rfl fun c _ => ?_
    have e1 : D n (-(c : ℤ), 0) = D n ((c : ℤ), 0) := D_negx n c 0
    have e2 : D n (0, (c : ℤ)) = D n ((c : ℤ), 0) := D_swap n c 0
    have e3 : D n (0, -(c : ℤ)) = D n ((c : ℤ), 0) := (D_swap n (-(c : ℤ)) 0).trans e1
    rw [e1, e2, e3]
    ring
  rw [ha, hP]
  nlinarith [hS, hG, hR]

name: A361622.a_eq_formula
statement: theorem a_eq_formula (n : ℕ) : a n = formula n
proof:
:= by
  have h := a_add_four_P n
  unfold formula
  omega

name: A347722.StepF.dd_val
statement: theorem dd_val (d : ℕ) (hd : d ≤ n) : (dd d hd).val = d
proof: := rfl

name: A347722.StepF.emb_val
statement:
theorem emb_val (d : ℕ) (i : Fin n) :
    (emb d i).val = if i.val < d then i.val else i.val + 1
proof: := rfl

name: A347722.StepF.emb_val_ne
statement: theorem emb_val_ne (d : ℕ) (i : Fin n) : (emb d i).val ≠ d
proof:
:= by
  rw [emb_val]; split <;> omega

name: A347722.StepF.emb_ne_dd
statement: theorem emb_ne_dd (d : ℕ) (hd : d ≤ n) (i : Fin n) : emb d i ≠ dd d hd
proof:
:=
  fun h => emb_val_ne d i (congrArg Fin.val h)

name: A347722.StepF.dd_ne_emb
statement: theorem dd_ne_emb (d : ℕ) (hd : d ≤ n) (i : Fin n) : dd d hd ≠ emb d i
proof:
:=
  fun h => emb_ne_dd d hd i h.symm

name: A347722.StepF.emb_inj
statement: theorem emb_inj {d : ℕ} {i j : Fin n} : emb d i = emb d j ↔ i = j
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have := congrArg Fin.val h
    rw [emb_val, emb_val] at this
    apply Fin.ext
    split at this <;> split at this <;> omega
  · rintro rfl; rfl

name: A347722.StepF.emb_lt
statement: theorem emb_lt {d : ℕ} {i j : Fin n} : emb d i < emb d j ↔ i < j
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fin.lt_def, Fin.lt_def, emb_val, emb_val]; split <;> split <;> omega

name: A347722.StepF.emb_val_lt
statement: theorem emb_val_lt {d : ℕ} {i : Fin n} : (emb d i).val < d ↔ i.val < d
proof:
:= by
  rw [emb_val]; split <;> omega

name: A347722.StepF.emb_ret
statement:
theorem emb_ret (d : ℕ) (hd : d ≤ n) (w : Fin (n + 1)) (h : w.val ≠ d) :
    emb d (ret d hd w h) = w
proof:
:= by
  apply Fin.ext
  have := w.isLt
  by_cases h1 : w.val < d
  · simp [emb, ret, h1]
  · have h2 : ¬ (w.val - 1 < d) := by omega
    simp only [emb, ret, if_neg h1, if_neg h2]
    omega

name: A347722.StepF.forall_split
statement:
theorem forall_split (d : ℕ) (hd : d ≤ n) {P : Fin (n + 1) → Prop} :
    (∀ w, P w) ↔ P (dd d hd) ∧ ∀ i, P (emb d i)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h; exact ⟨h _, fun i => h _⟩
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩ w
    by_cases h : w.val = d
    · have hw : w = dd d hd := Fin.ext h
      rw [hw]; exact h1
    · rw [← emb_ret d hd w h]; exact h2 _

name: A347722.StepF.exists_split
statement:
theorem exists_split (d : ℕ) (hd : d ≤ n) {P : Fin (n + 1) → Prop} :
    (∃ w, P w) ↔ P (dd d hd) ∨ ∃ i, P (emb d i)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨w, hw⟩
    by_cases h : w.val = d
    · have hw' : w = dd d hd := Fin.ext h
      left; rw [← hw']; exact hw
    · right; exact ⟨ret d hd w h, by rw [emb_ret]; exact hw⟩
  · rintro (h | ⟨i, h⟩)
    · exact ⟨_, h⟩
    · exact ⟨_, h⟩

name: A347722.StepF.Phi_emb
statement: theorem Phi_emb (i : Fin n) : Phi d hd g' (emb d i) = emb d (g' i)
proof:
:= by
  unfold Phi
  rw [dif_neg (emb_val_ne d i), emb_inj.1 (emb_ret d hd (emb d i) (emb_val_ne d i))]

name: A347722.StepF.Phi_dd
statement: theorem Phi_dd : Phi d hd g' (dd d hd) = dd d hd
proof:
:= by
  unfold Phi
  rw [dif_pos (dd_val d hd)]

name: A347722.StepF.idem_Phi
statement: theorem idem_Phi : Idem (Phi d hd g') ↔ Idem g'
proof:
:= by
  unfold Idem
  rw [forall_split d hd]
  simp [Phi_dd, Phi_emb, emb_inj]

name: A347722.StepF.isoAt_Phi_emb
statement: theorem isoAt_Phi_emb {i : Fin n} : IsoAt (Phi d hd g') (emb d i) ↔ IsoAt g' i
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsoAt
  rw [forall_split d hd]
  simp [Phi_dd, Phi_emb, emb_inj, dd_ne_emb]

name: A347722.StepF.isoAt_Phi_dd
statement: theorem isoAt_Phi_dd : IsoAt (Phi d hd g') (dd d hd)
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsoAt
  rw [forall_split d hd]
  simp [Phi_dd, Phi_emb, emb_ne_dd]

name: A347722.StepF.badAt_Phi_emb
statement: theorem badAt_Phi_emb {i : Fin n} : BadAt (Phi d hd g') (emb d i) ↔ BadAt g' i
proof:
:= by
  unfold BadAt
  rw [Phi_emb, emb_inj, exists_split d hd]
  have key : ∀ j, (∀ w, Phi d hd g' w = emb d i → w = emb d j ∨ w = emb d i) ↔
      (∀ w, g' w = i → w = j ∨ w = i) := by
    intro j
    rw [forall_split d hd]
    simp [Phi_dd, Phi_emb, emb_inj, dd_ne_emb]
  simp [Phi_dd, Phi_emb, emb_inj, emb_lt, dd_ne_emb, key]

name: A347722.StepF.not_badAt_Phi_dd
statement: theorem not_badAt_Phi_dd : ¬ BadAt (Phi d hd g') (dd d hd)
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ u, u < dd d hd → Phi d hd g' u ≠ dd d hd := by
    rw [forall_split d hd]
    refine ⟨fun h => absurd h (lt_irrefl _), fun j _ h => ?_⟩
    rw [Phi_emb] at h
    exact emb_ne_dd _ _ _ h
  rintro ⟨_, u, hu, hgu, _⟩
  exact h u hu hgu

name: A347722.StepF.good_Phi
statement: theorem good_Phi : Good (Phi d hd g') ↔ Good g'
proof:
:= by
  unfold Good
  rw [idem_Phi, forall_split d hd]
  simp [badAt_Phi_emb, not_badAt_Phi_dd]

name: A347722.StepF.noiso_Phi
statement:
theorem noiso_Phi :
    (∀ v : Fin (n + 1), v.val < d → ¬ IsoAt (Phi d hd g') v) ↔
      ∀ v : Fin n, v.val < d → ¬ IsoAt g' v
proof:
:= by
  rw [forall_split d hd]
  simp [isoAt_Phi_emb, emb_val_lt, dd_val]

name: A347722.StepF.Phi_inj
statement: theorem Phi_inj {g₁ g₂ : Fin n → Fin n} (h : Phi d hd g₁ = Phi d hd g₂) : g₁ = g₂
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  have := congrFun h (emb d i)
  rwa [Phi_emb, Phi_emb, emb_inj] at this

name: A347722.StepF.Phi_surj
statement:
theorem Phi_surj (d : ℕ) (hd : d ≤ n) (g : Fin (n + 1) → Fin (n + 1))
    (hg : IsoAt g (dd d hd)) : ∃ g', Phi d hd g' = g
proof:
:= by
  have hne : ∀ i, (g (emb d i)).val ≠ d :=
    fun i h => emb_ne_dd d hd i ((hg _).1 (Fin.ext h))
  refine ⟨fun i => ret d hd (g (emb d i)) (hne i), ?_⟩
  funext w
  revert w
  rw [forall_split d hd]
  refine ⟨?_, fun i => ?_⟩
  · rw [Phi_dd]; exact ((hg _).2 rfl).symm
  · rw [Phi_emb, emb_ret]

name: A347722.F_zero
statement: theorem F_zero (n : ℕ) : F n 0 = D n n
proof:
:= by
  unfold F D
  congr 1
  apply Finset.filter_congr
  intro g _
  simp [Good]

name: A347722.F_succ
statement: theorem F_succ (n d : ℕ) (hd : d ≤ n) : F (n + 1) (d + 1) + F n d = F (n + 1) d
proof:
:= by
  have hV : F n d = (Finset.univ.filter fun g : Fin (n + 1) → Fin (n + 1) =>
      (Good g ∧ ∀ v : Fin (n + 1), v.val < d → ¬ IsoAt g v) ∧ IsoAt g (dd d hd)).card := by
    unfold F
    apply Finset.card_bij (fun g' _ => Phi d hd g')
    · intro g' hg'
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hg' ⊢
      exact ⟨⟨good_Phi.2 hg'.1, noiso_Phi.2 hg'.2⟩, isoAt_Phi_dd⟩
    · intro a _ b _ h
      exact Phi_inj h
    · intro g hg
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hg
      obtain ⟨g', rfl⟩ := Phi_surj d hd g hg.2
      refine ⟨g', ?_, rfl⟩
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
      exact ⟨good_Phi.1 hg.1.1, noiso_Phi.1 hg.1.2⟩
  have hS : F (n + 1) (d + 1) = (Finset.univ.filter fun g : Fin (n + 1) → Fin (n + 1) =>
      (Good g ∧ ∀ v : Fin (n + 1), v.val < d → ¬ IsoAt g v) ∧ ¬ IsoAt g (dd d hd)).card := by
    unfold F
    congr 1
    apply Finset.filter_congr
    intro g _
    have key : (∀ v : Fin (n + 1), v.val < d + 1 → ¬ IsoAt g v) ↔
        (∀ v : Fin (n + 1), v.val < d → ¬ IsoAt g v) ∧ ¬ IsoAt g (dd d hd) := by
      constructor
      · intro h
        exact ⟨fun v hv => h v (by omega), h _ (by rw [dd_val]; omega)⟩
      · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩ v hv
        by_cases h : v.val = d
        · have hv' : v = dd d hd := Fin.ext h
          rw [hv']; exact h2
        · exact h1 v (by omega)
    rw [key, and_assoc]
  have hsplit := Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not
    (s := Finset.univ.filter fun g : Fin (n + 1) → Fin (n + 1) =>
      Good g ∧ ∀ v : Fin (n + 1), v.val < d → ¬ IsoAt g v)
    (fun g => IsoAt g (dd d hd))
  rw [Finset.filter_filter, Finset.filter_filter] at hsplit
  rw [hV, hS, add_comm]
  exact hsplit

name: A347722.Base.fiber_eq
statement:
theorem fiber_eq {n : ℕ} (A : Finset (Fin n)) :
    (univ.filter fun g : Fin n → Fin n => Idem g ∧ (univ.filter fun v => g v = v) = A)
      = Fintype.piFinset (fun v => if v ∈ A then {v} else A)
proof:
:= by
  ext g
  simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, Fintype.mem_piFinset]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hI, rfl⟩ v
    by_cases hv : g v = v
    · simp [hv]
    · simp [hv, hI v]
  · intro H
    have h1 : ∀ v ∈ A, g v = v := fun v hv => by simpa [hv] using H v
    have h2 : ∀ v, v ∉ A → g v ∈ A := fun v hv => by simpa [hv] using H v
    refine ⟨fun v => ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hgv : g v ∈ A := by
        by_cases hv : v ∈ A
        · rw [h1 v hv]; exact hv
        · exact h2 v hv
      exact h1 _ hgv
    · ext v
      simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
      refine ⟨fun e => ?_, h1 v⟩
      by_contra hv
      exact hv (e ▸ h2 v hv)

name: A347722.Base.card_fiber
statement:
theorem card_fiber {n : ℕ} (A : Finset (Fin n)) :
    (univ.filter fun g : Fin n → Fin n => Idem g ∧ (univ.filter fun v => g v = v) = A).card
      = A.card ^ (n - A.card)
proof:
:= by
  rw [fiber_eq, Fintype.card_piFinset]
  have : ∀ v : Fin n, (if v ∈ A then ({v} : Finset (Fin n)) else A).card
      = if v ∈ A then 1 else A.card := fun v => by split_ifs <;> simp
  simp only [this]
  have hc : (univ.filter fun v : Fin n => v ∉ A) = Aᶜ := by ext v; simp
  rw [prod_ite, prod_const_one, one_mul, prod_const, hc, card_compl, Fintype.card_fin]

name: A347722.Base.card_idem
statement:
theorem card_idem (n : ℕ) :
    (univ.filter fun g : Fin n → Fin n => Idem g).card = h n
proof:
:= by
  rw [card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise (f := fun g : Fin n → Fin n => univ.filter fun v => g v = v)
    (t := (univ : Finset (Fin n)).powerset) (fun g _ => by simp)]
  simp only [filter_filter, card_fiber]
  rw [sum_powerset_apply_card (fun k => k ^ (n - k))]
  simp [h]

name: A347722.D_zero
statement: theorem D_zero (n : ℕ) : D n 0 = h n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Base.card_idem]
  unfold D
  congr 1
  apply Finset.filter_congr
  intro g _
  simp

name: A347722.Bridge2.pair_ne
statement: theorem pair_ne (hS : S ⊆ verts n) {x y : Fin n} (h : {x, y} ∈ S) : x ≠ y
proof:
:= by
  rintro rfl
  have := hS h
  simp [verts, Finset.mem_powersetCard] at this

name: A347722.Bridge2.edge_form
statement:
theorem edge_form (hS : S ⊆ verts n) {e : Finset (Fin n)} (h : e ∈ S) :
    ∃ x y, x ≠ y ∧ e = {x, y}
proof:
:= by
  have := hS h
  rw [verts, Finset.mem_powersetCard] at this
  exact Finset.card_eq_two.mp this.2

name: A347722.Bridge2.edge_unique
statement:
theorem edge_unique {v : Fin n} (hv : deg S v = 1) {e e' : Finset (Fin n)} (he : e ∈ S)
    (hve : v ∈ e) (he' : e' ∈ S) (hve' : v ∈ e') : e = e'
proof:
:= by
  have h : (S.filter fun e => v ∈ e).card ≤ 1 := le_of_eq hv
  exact Finset.card_le_one.mp h e (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨he, hve⟩) e'
    (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨he', hve'⟩)

name: A347722.Bridge2.exists_nbr
statement:
theorem exists_nbr (hS : S ⊆ verts n) {v : Fin n} (hv : deg S v = 1) :
    ∃ u, u ≠ v ∧ {v, u} ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  have h : 0 < deg S v := by omega
  unfold deg at h
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := Finset.card_pos.mp h
  rw [Finset.mem_filter] at he
  obtain ⟨he, hve⟩ := he
  obtain ⟨x, y, hxy, rfl⟩ := edge_form hS he
  rw [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hve
  rcases hve with hvx | hvy
  · subst hvx
    exact ⟨y, hxy.symm, he⟩
  · subst hvy
    exact ⟨x, hxy, by rw [Finset.pair_comm]; exact he⟩

name: A347722.Bridge2.pair_unique
statement:
theorem pair_unique {v u w : Fin n} (hv : deg S v = 1) (hu : {v, u} ∈ S) (hw : {v, w} ∈ S)
    (huv : u ≠ v) : u = w
proof:
:= by
  have h := edge_unique hv hu (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _) hw (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)
  have hmem : u ∈ ({v, w} : Finset (Fin n)) := by rw [← h]; simp
  rw [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hmem
  rcases hmem with h1 | h1
  · exact absurd h1 huv
  · exact h1

name: A347722.Bridge2.exists_other
statement:
theorem exists_other (hS : S ⊆ verts n) {v u : Fin n} (hu : {v, u} ∈ S) (hv : deg S v ≠ 1) :
    ∃ w, w ≠ v ∧ w ≠ u ∧ {v, w} ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hcon
  apply hv
  have hfil : (S.filter fun e => v ∈ e) = {{v, u}} := by
    ext e
    rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_singleton]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨he, hve⟩
      obtain ⟨x, y, hxy, rfl⟩ := edge_form hS he
      rw [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hve
      rcases hve with hvx | hvy
      · subst hvx
        by_contra hne
        exact hcon ⟨y, hxy.symm, fun h => hne (by rw [h]), he⟩
      · subst hvy
        by_contra hne
        exact hcon ⟨x, hxy, fun h => hne (by rw [h, Finset.pair_comm]),
          by rw [Finset.pair_comm]; exact he⟩
    · rintro rfl
      exact ⟨hu, Finset.mem_insert_self _ _⟩
  unfold deg
  rw [hfil, Finset.card_singleton]

name: A347722.Bridge2.star_pair
statement:
theorem star_pair (h : Star S) {x y : Fin n} (hxy : {x, y} ∈ S) :
    deg S x = 1 ∨ deg S y = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hd⟩ := h _ hxy
  rw [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hv
  rcases hv with rfl | rfl
  · exact Or.inl hd
  · exact Or.inr hd

name: A347722.Bridge2.nbr_spec
statement:
theorem nbr_spec (hS : S ⊆ verts n) {v : Fin n} (hv : deg S v = 1) :
    nbr S v ≠ v ∧ {v, nbr S v} ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  have h := exists_nbr hS hv
  unfold nbr
  rw [dif_pos h]
  exact Classical.choose_spec h

name: A347722.Bridge2.nbr_eq
statement:
theorem nbr_eq (hS : S ⊆ verts n) {v u : Fin n} (hv : deg S v = 1) (hu : {v, u} ∈ S) :
    nbr S v = u
proof:
:=
  pair_unique hv (nbr_spec hS hv).2 hu (nbr_spec hS hv).1

name: A347722.Bridge2.nbr_nbr
statement:
theorem nbr_nbr (hS : S ⊆ verts n) {v : Fin n} (hv : deg S v = 1)
    (h2 : deg S (nbr S v) = 1) : nbr S (nbr S v) = v
proof:
:=
  nbr_eq hS h2 (by rw [Finset.pair_comm]; exact (nbr_spec hS hv).2)

name: A347722.Bridge2.gmap_of_ne
statement: theorem gmap_of_ne {v : Fin n} (h : deg S v ≠ 1) : gmap S v = v
proof:
:= by
  unfold gmap
  rw [if_neg h]

name: A347722.Bridge2.gmap_of_one_ne
statement:
theorem gmap_of_one_ne {v : Fin n} (h : deg S v = 1) (h2 : deg S (nbr S v) ≠ 1) :
    gmap S v = nbr S v
proof:
:= by
  unfold gmap
  rw [if_pos h, if_neg h2]

name: A347722.Bridge2.gmap_of_one_one
statement:
theorem gmap_of_one_one {v : Fin n} (h : deg S v = 1) (h2 : deg S (nbr S v) = 1) :
    gmap S v = min v (nbr S v)
proof:
:= by
  unfold gmap
  rw [if_pos h, if_pos h2]

name: A347722.Bridge2.gmap_ne
statement: theorem gmap_ne {v : Fin n} (h : gmap S v ≠ v) : deg S v = 1 ∧ gmap S v = nbr S v
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : deg S v = 1 := by
    by_contra h1
    exact h (gmap_of_ne h1)
  refine ⟨h1, ?_⟩
  by_cases h2 : deg S (nbr S v) = 1
  · rw [gmap_of_one_one h1 h2] at h ⊢
    rcases le_total v (nbr S v) with hle | hle
    · exact absurd (min_eq_left hle) h
    · exact min_eq_right hle
  · exact gmap_of_one_ne h1 h2

name: A347722.Bridge2.gmap_idem
statement: theorem gmap_idem (hS : S ⊆ verts n) : Idem (gmap S)
proof:
:= by
  intro v
  by_cases hfix : gmap S v = v
  · rw [hfix, hfix]
  · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := gmap_ne hfix
    rw [h2]
    by_cases h3 : deg S (nbr S v) = 1
    · have hmin := gmap_of_one_one h1 h3
      rw [h2] at hmin
      have hle : nbr S v ≤ v := hmin.le.trans (min_le_left _ _)
      rw [gmap_of_one_one h3 (by rw [nbr_nbr hS h1 h3]; exact h1), nbr_nbr hS h1 h3]
      exact min_eq_left hle
    · exact gmap_of_ne h3

name: A347722.Bridge2.gmap_not_bad
statement: theorem gmap_not_bad (hS : S ⊆ verts n) (hst : Star S) (c : Fin n) : ¬ BadAt (gmap S) c
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨-, x, hxc, hgx, hall⟩
  have hne : gmap S x ≠ x := by rw [hgx]; exact (ne_of_lt hxc).symm
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := gmap_ne hne
  have hnc : nbr S x = c := h2.symm.trans hgx
  have hc : deg S c ≠ 1 := by
    intro hc
    have hmin := gmap_of_one_one h1 (by rw [hnc]; exact hc)
    rw [hgx, hnc] at hmin
    have hle : c ≤ x := hmin.le.trans (min_le_left _ _)
    exact absurd hxc (not_lt.mpr hle)
  have hxS : {c, x} ∈ S := by
    have := (nbr_spec hS h1).2
    rw [hnc, Finset.pair_comm] at this
    exact this
  obtain ⟨w, hwc, hwx, hw⟩ := exists_other hS hxS hc
  have hdw : deg S w = 1 := (star_pair hst hw).resolve_left hc
  have hnw : nbr S w = c := nbr_eq hS hdw (by rw [Finset.pair_comm]; exact hw)
  have hgw : gmap S w = c := by rw [gmap_of_one_ne hdw (by rw [hnw]; exact hc), hnw]
  rcases hall w hgw with h | h
  · exact hwx h
  · exact hwc h

name: A347722.Bridge2.mem_edgeSet
statement:
theorem mem_edgeSet {g : Fin n → Fin n} {e : Finset (Fin n)} :
    e ∈ edgeSet g ↔ ∃ v, g v ≠ v ∧ {v, g v} = e
proof:
:= by
  unfold edgeSet
  rw [Finset.mem_image]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨v, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hv).2, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨v, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hv⟩, rfl⟩

name: A347722.Bridge2.pair_mem_edgeSet
statement:
theorem pair_mem_edgeSet (hS : S ⊆ verts n) {x y : Fin n} (hxy : {x, y} ∈ S)
    (hx : deg S x = 1) : {x, y} ∈ edgeSet (gmap S)
proof:
:= by
  have hne := pair_ne hS hxy
  have hnx : nbr S x = y := nbr_eq hS hx hxy
  rw [mem_edgeSet]
  by_cases hy : deg S y = 1
  · have hny : nbr S y = x := nbr_eq hS hy (by rw [Finset.pair_comm]; exact hxy)
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hlt | hlt
    · have hg : gmap S y = x := by
        rw [gmap_of_one_one hy (by rw [hny]; exact hx), hny]
        exact min_eq_right hlt.le
      exact ⟨y, by rw [hg]; exact hne, by rw [hg, Finset.pair_comm]⟩
    · have hg : gmap S x = y := by
        rw [gmap_of_one_one hx (by rw [hnx]; exact hy), hnx]
        exact min_eq_right hlt.le
      exact ⟨x, by rw [hg]; exact hne.symm, by rw [hg]⟩
  · have hg : gmap S x = y := by rw [gmap_of_one_ne hx (by rw [hnx]; exact hy), hnx]
    exact ⟨x, by rw [hg]; exact hne.symm, by rw [hg]⟩

name: A347722.exists_good_of_star
statement:
theorem exists_good_of_star {n : ℕ} (S : Finset (Finset (Fin n))) (hS : S ⊆ verts n)
    (h : Star S) : ∃ g : Fin n → Fin n, Good g ∧ edgeSet g = S
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Bridge2.gmap S, ⟨Bridge2.gmap_idem hS, Bridge2.gmap_not_bad hS h⟩, ?_⟩
  ext e
  rw [Bridge2.mem_edgeSet]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := Bridge2.gmap_ne hv
    rw [h2]
    exact (Bridge2.nbr_spec hS h1).2
  · intro he
    obtain ⟨x, y, -, rfl⟩ := Bridge2.edge_form hS he
    rw [← Bridge2.mem_edgeSet]
    rcases Bridge2.star_pair h he with hx | hy
    · exact Bridge2.pair_mem_edgeSet hS he hx
    · rw [Finset.pair_comm]
      exact Bridge2.pair_mem_edgeSet hS (by rw [Finset.pair_comm]; exact he) hy

name: A347722.Bridge1.mem_edgeSet
statement:
theorem mem_edgeSet (g : Fin n → Fin n) (e : Finset (Fin n)) :
    e ∈ edgeSet g ↔ ∃ v, g v ≠ v ∧ {v, g v} = e
proof:
:= by
  simp only [edgeSet, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]

name: A347722.Bridge1.pair_mem
statement:
theorem pair_mem (g : Fin n → Fin n) (a b : Fin n) (h : g a = b) (hab : a ≠ b) :
    ({a, b} : Finset (Fin n)) ∈ edgeSet g
proof:
:=
  (mem_edgeSet g _).2 ⟨a, by rw [h]; exact hab.symm, by rw [h]⟩

name: A347722.Bridge1.of_pair_mem
statement:
theorem of_pair_mem (g : Fin n → Fin n) (a b : Fin n)
    (h : ({a, b} : Finset (Fin n)) ∈ edgeSet g) : g a = b ∨ g b = a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, he⟩ := (mem_edgeSet g _).1 h
  have h1 : x = a ∨ x = b := by
    have hm : x ∈ ({x, g x} : Finset (Fin n)) := Finset.mem_insert_self _ _
    rw [he, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hm
    exact hm
  have h2 : g x = a ∨ g x = b := by
    have hm : g x ∈ ({x, g x} : Finset (Fin n)) := by
      rw [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]; exact Or.inr rfl
    rw [he, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hm
    exact hm
  rcases h1 with rfl | rfl
  · rcases h2 with h2 | h2
    · exact absurd h2 hx
    · exact Or.inl h2
  · rcases h2 with h2 | h2
    · exact Or.inr h2
    · exact absurd h2 hx

name: A347722.Bridge1.deg_of_ne
statement:
theorem deg_of_ne (g : Fin n → Fin n) (hg : Idem g) (v : Fin n) (hv : g v ≠ v) :
    deg (edgeSet g) v = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold deg
  rw [Finset.card_eq_one]
  refine ⟨{v, g v}, ?_⟩
  ext e
  rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_singleton, mem_edgeSet]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨w, hw, rfl⟩, hve⟩
    rw [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hve
    rcases hve with rfl | h
    · rfl
    · exact absurd (by rw [h, hg w]) hv
  · rintro rfl
    exact ⟨⟨v, hv, rfl⟩, Finset.mem_insert_self _ _⟩

name: A347722.Bridge1.deg_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem deg_eq_zero_iff (g : Fin n → Fin n) (v : Fin n) (hv : g v = v) :
    deg (edgeSet g) v = 0 ↔ ∀ w, g w = v → w = v
proof:
:= by
  unfold deg
  rw [Finset.card_eq_zero, Finset.filter_eq_empty_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h w hw
    by_contra hne
    refine h (pair_mem g w v hw hne) ?_
    rw [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
    exact Or.inr rfl
  · intro h e he hve
    obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := (mem_edgeSet g _).1 he
    rw [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hve
    rcases hve with rfl | h'
    · exact hw hv
    · exact hw (h'.symm.trans (h w h'.symm).symm)

name: A347722.Bridge1.half
statement:
theorem half (g₁ g₂ : Fin n → Fin n) (h₁ : Good g₁) (hi2 : Idem g₂)
    (h : edgeSet g₁ = edgeSet g₂) (v w : Fin n) (hvw : v ≠ w) (hw1 : g₁ v = w)
    (hw2 : g₂ w = v) : ¬ v < w
proof:
:= by
  intro hlt
  have hfix : g₁ w = w := by rw [← hw1]; exact h₁.1 v
  refine h₁.2 w ⟨hfix, v, hlt, hw1, fun y hy => ?_⟩
  by_cases hyw : y = w
  · exact Or.inr hyw
  · left
    have hm : ({y, w} : Finset (Fin n)) ∈ edgeSet g₂ := by
      rw [← h]; exact pair_mem g₁ y w hy hyw
    rcases of_pair_mem g₂ _ _ hm with h' | h'
    · exfalso
      have h3 : g₂ w = w := by rw [← h']; exact hi2 y
      exact hvw (hw2.symm.trans h3)
    · exact h'.symm.trans hw2

name: A347722.Bridge1.one_sided
statement:
theorem one_sided (g₁ g₂ : Fin n → Fin n) (h₁ : Good g₁) (h₂ : Good g₂)
    (h : edgeSet g₁ = edgeSet g₂) (v : Fin n) (hv : g₁ v ≠ v) : g₂ v = g₁ v
proof:
:= by
  have hm : ({v, g₁ v} : Finset (Fin n)) ∈ edgeSet g₂ := by
    rw [← h]; exact pair_mem g₁ v _ rfl (Ne.symm hv)
  rcases of_pair_mem g₂ _ _ hm with h' | h'
  · exact h'
  · exfalso
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne (Ne.symm hv) with hlt | hlt
    · exact half g₁ g₂ h₁ h₂.1 h v (g₁ v) (Ne.symm hv) rfl h' hlt
    · exact half g₂ g₁ h₂ h₁.1 h.symm (g₁ v) v hv h' rfl hlt

name: A347722.edgeSet_subset
statement: theorem edgeSet_subset {n : ℕ} (g : Fin n → Fin n) : edgeSet g ⊆ verts n
proof:
:= by
  intro e he
  obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := (mem_edgeSet g _).1 he
  unfold verts
  rw [Finset.mem_powersetCard]
  exact ⟨Finset.subset_univ _, Finset.card_pair (Ne.symm hv)⟩

name: A347722.star_edgeSet
statement: theorem star_edgeSet {n : ℕ} (g : Fin n → Fin n) (hg : Idem g) : Star (edgeSet g)
proof:
:= by
  intro e he
  obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := (mem_edgeSet g _).1 he
  exact ⟨v, Finset.mem_insert_self _ _, deg_of_ne g hg v hv⟩

name: A347722.unc_edgeSet_iff
statement:
theorem unc_edgeSet_iff {n : ℕ} (g : Fin n → Fin n) (hg : Idem g) :
    Unc (edgeSet g) ↔ ∃ v, IsoAt g v
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v, hv⟩
    have hfix : g v = v := by
      by_contra hne
      rw [deg_of_ne g hg v hne] at hv
      exact one_ne_zero hv
    exact ⟨v, fun w => ⟨(deg_eq_zero_iff g v hfix).1 hv w, fun hwv => by rw [hwv]; exact hfix⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨v, hv⟩
    exact ⟨v, (deg_eq_zero_iff g v ((hv v).2 rfl)).2 fun w hw => (hv w).1 hw⟩

name: A347722.edgeSet_injective
statement:
theorem edgeSet_injective {n : ℕ} (g₁ g₂ : Fin n → Fin n) (h₁ : Good g₁) (h₂ : Good g₂)
    (h : edgeSet g₁ = edgeSet g₂) : g₁ = g₂
proof:
:= by
  funext v
  by_cases ha : g₁ v = v
  · by_cases hb : g₂ v = v
    · rw [ha, hb]
    · exact absurd ((one_sided g₂ g₁ h₂ h₁ h.symm v hb).symm.trans ha) hb
  · exact (one_sided g₁ g₂ h₁ h₂ h v ha).symm

name: A347722.StepD.emb_lt
statement: theorem emb_lt (a b i m : ℕ) (hi : i < m) : emb a b i < m + 2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [emb]; split_ifs <;> omega

name: A347722.StepD.emb_ne_a
statement: theorem emb_ne_a (a b i : ℕ) (_h : a < b) : emb a b i ≠ a
proof:
:= by
  simp only [emb]; split_ifs <;> omega

name: A347722.StepD.emb_ne_b
statement: theorem emb_ne_b (a b i : ℕ) (h : a < b) : emb a b i ≠ b
proof:
:= by
  simp only [emb]; split_ifs <;> omega

name: A347722.StepD.inv_emb
statement: theorem inv_emb (a b i : ℕ) (_h : a < b) : inv a b (emb a b i) = i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [emb, inv]; split_ifs <;> omega

name: A347722.StepD.emb_inv
statement: theorem emb_inv (a b w : ℕ) (h : a < b) (h1 : w ≠ a) (h2 : w ≠ b) : emb a b (inv a b w) = w
proof:
:= by
  simp only [emb, inv]; split_ifs <;> omega

name: A347722.StepD.inv_lt
statement:
theorem inv_lt (a b w m : ℕ) (h : a < b) (hb : b < m + 2) (hw : w < m + 2) (h1 : w ≠ a)
    (h2 : w ≠ b) : inv a b w < m
proof:
:= by
  simp only [inv]; split_ifs <;> omega

name: A347722.StepD.emb_lt_emb
statement: theorem emb_lt_emb (a b i j : ℕ) : emb a b i < emb a b j ↔ i < j
proof:
:= by
  simp only [emb]; split_ifs <;> omega

name: A347722.StepD.emb_lt_b
statement: theorem emb_lt_b (a b i : ℕ) (h : a < b) : emb a b i < b ↔ i < b - 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [emb]; split_ifs <;> omega

name: A347722.StepD.E_ne_u
statement: theorem E_ne_u (h : u < cc) (i : Fin m) : E u cc i ≠ u
proof:
:= fun H =>
  emb_ne_a _ _ _ (Fin.lt_def.mp h) (congrArg Fin.val H)

name: A347722.StepD.E_ne_cc
statement: theorem E_ne_cc (h : u < cc) (i : Fin m) : E u cc i ≠ cc
proof:
:= fun H =>
  emb_ne_b _ _ _ (Fin.lt_def.mp h) (congrArg Fin.val H)

name: A347722.StepD.E_inj
statement: theorem E_inj (h : u < cc) {i j : Fin m} (H : E u cc i = E u cc j) : i = j
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : emb u cc i = emb u cc j := congrArg Fin.val H
  have h2 := inv_emb u cc i (Fin.lt_def.mp h)
  rw [h1, inv_emb u cc j (Fin.lt_def.mp h)] at h2
  exact Fin.ext h2.symm

name: A347722.StepD.E_R
statement:
theorem E_R (h : u < cc) (w : Fin (m + 2)) (hw : ¬(w = u ∨ w = cc)) :
    E u cc (R u cc h w hw) = w
proof:
:=
  Fin.ext (emb_inv _ _ _ (Fin.lt_def.mp h)
    (fun e => hw (Or.inl (Fin.ext e))) (fun e => hw (Or.inr (Fin.ext e))))

name: A347722.StepD.R_E
statement:
theorem R_E (h : u < cc) (i : Fin m) (hw : ¬(E u cc i = u ∨ E u cc i = cc)) :
    R u cc h (E u cc i) hw = i
proof:
:=
  Fin.ext (inv_emb _ _ _ (Fin.lt_def.mp h))

name: A347722.StepD.cases
statement: theorem cases (h : u < cc) (w : Fin (m + 2)) : w = u ∨ w = cc ∨ ∃ i, w = E u cc i
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hw : w = u ∨ w = cc
  · rcases hw with e | e
    · exact Or.inl e
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl e)
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨R u cc h w hw, (E_R h w hw).symm⟩)

name: A347722.StepD.E_lt_iff
statement: theorem E_lt_iff (_h : u < cc) {i j : Fin m} : E u cc i < E u cc j ↔ i < j
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fin.lt_def, Fin.lt_def]; exact emb_lt_emb _ _ _ _

name: A347722.StepD.E_val_lt
statement: theorem E_val_lt (h : u < cc) (i : Fin m) : (E u cc i).val < cc.val ↔ i.val < cc.val - 1
proof:
:=
  emb_lt_b _ _ _ (Fin.lt_def.mp h)

name: A347722.StepD.Phi_u
statement: theorem Phi_u (h : u < cc) (g' : Fin m → Fin m) : Phi u cc h g' u = cc
proof:
:= by
  simp [Phi]

name: A347722.StepD.Phi_cc
statement: theorem Phi_cc (h : u < cc) (g' : Fin m → Fin m) : Phi u cc h g' cc = cc
proof:
:= by
  simp [Phi]

name: A347722.StepD.Phi_E
statement:
theorem Phi_E (h : u < cc) (g' : Fin m → Fin m) (i : Fin m) :
    Phi u cc h g' (E u cc i) = E u cc (g' i)
proof:
:= by
  have hw : ¬(E u cc i = u ∨ E u cc i = cc) := not_or.mpr ⟨E_ne_u h i, E_ne_cc h i⟩
  unfold Phi
  rw [dif_neg hw, R_E]

name: A347722.StepD.E_Psi
statement:
theorem E_Psi (h : u < cc) (g : Fin (m + 2) → Fin (m + 2)) (i : Fin m)
    (hw : ¬(g (E u cc i) = u ∨ g (E u cc i) = cc)) : E u cc (Psi u cc h g i) = g (E u cc i)
proof:
:= by
  unfold Psi
  rw [dif_neg hw, E_R]

name: A347722.StepD.Phi_eq_cc
statement:
theorem Phi_eq_cc (h : u < cc) (g' : Fin m → Fin m) {w : Fin (m + 2)}
    (hw : Phi u cc h g' w = cc) : w = u ∨ w = cc
proof:
:= by
  rcases cases h w with e | e | ⟨i, e⟩
  · exact Or.inl e
  · exact Or.inr e
  · rw [e, Phi_E] at hw
    exact absurd hw (E_ne_cc h _)

name: A347722.StepD.badAt_Phi_E
statement:
theorem badAt_Phi_E (h : u < cc) (g' : Fin m → Fin m) (i : Fin m) :
    BadAt (Phi u cc h g') (E u cc i) ↔ BadAt g' i
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hfix, x, hx, hgx, huniq⟩
    rw [Phi_E] at hfix
    rcases cases h x with e | e | ⟨j, e⟩
    · rw [e, Phi_u] at hgx
      exact absurd hgx.symm (E_ne_cc h i)
    · rw [e, Phi_cc] at hgx
      exact absurd hgx.symm (E_ne_cc h i)
    · rw [e, Phi_E] at hgx
      rw [e] at hx
      refine ⟨E_inj h hfix, j, (E_lt_iff h).mp hx, E_inj h hgx, fun w hw => ?_⟩
      have hw' : Phi u cc h g' (E u cc w) = E u cc i := by rw [Phi_E, hw]
      rcases huniq (E u cc w) hw' with e' | e'
      · left; rw [e] at e'; exact E_inj h e'
      · right; exact E_inj h e'
  · rintro ⟨hfix, j, hj, hgj, huniq⟩
    refine ⟨by rw [Phi_E, hfix], E u cc j, (E_lt_iff h).mpr hj, by rw [Phi_E, hgj],
      fun w hw => ?_⟩
    rcases cases h w with e | e | ⟨k, e⟩
    · rw [e, Phi_u] at hw
      exact absurd hw.symm (E_ne_cc h i)
    · rw [e, Phi_cc] at hw
      exact absurd hw.symm (E_ne_cc h i)
    · rw [e, Phi_E] at hw
      rcases huniq k (E_inj h hw) with e' | e'
      · left; rw [e, e']
      · right; rw [e, e']

name: A347722.StepD.Phi_mem
statement:
theorem Phi_mem (h : u < cc) (g' : Fin m → Fin m) (hI : Idem g')
    (hB : ∀ v : Fin m, v.val < cc.val - 1 → ¬BadAt g' v) :
    Idem (Phi u cc h g') ∧ (∀ v : Fin (m + 2), v.val < cc.val → ¬BadAt (Phi u cc h g') v) ∧
      BadAt (Phi u cc h g') cc
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro w
    rcases cases h w with e | e | ⟨i, e⟩
    · rw [e, Phi_u, Phi_cc]
    · rw [e, Phi_cc, Phi_cc]
    · rw [e, Phi_E, Phi_E, hI i]
  · intro v hv hbad
    rcases cases h v with e | e | ⟨i, e⟩
    · rw [e] at hbad
      have h1 := hbad.1
      rw [Phi_u] at h1
      exact absurd h1.symm (ne_of_lt h)
    · rw [e] at hv
      exact lt_irrefl _ hv
    · rw [e] at hv hbad
      exact hB i ((E_val_lt h i).mp hv) ((badAt_Phi_E h g' i).mp hbad)
  · exact ⟨Phi_cc h g', u, h, Phi_u h g', fun w hw => Phi_eq_cc h g' hw⟩

name: A347722.StepD.Psi_spec
statement:
theorem Psi_spec (h : u < cc) (g : Fin (m + 2) → Fin (m + 2)) (hI : Idem g)
    (hB : ∀ v : Fin (m + 2), v.val < cc.val → ¬BadAt g v) (hbad : BadAt g cc) (hu : g u = cc) :
    (Idem (Psi u cc h g) ∧ ∀ v : Fin m, v.val < cc.val - 1 → ¬BadAt (Psi u cc h g) v) ∧
      Phi u cc h (Psi u cc h g) = g
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hfix, u0, -, -, huniq⟩ := hbad
  have hne : u ≠ cc := ne_of_lt h
  have key : ∀ w, g w = cc → w = u ∨ w = cc := by
    intro w hw
    rcases huniq u hu with e | e
    · rw [e]; exact huniq w hw
    · exact absurd e hne
  have nou : ∀ w, g w ≠ u := by
    intro w hw
    have h1 := hI w
    rw [hw, hu] at h1
    exact hne h1.symm
  have hE : ∀ i, E u cc (Psi u cc h g i) = g (E u cc i) := by
    intro i
    apply E_Psi
    rintro (e | e)
    · exact nou _ e
    · rcases key _ e with e' | e'
      · exact E_ne_u h i e'
      · exact E_ne_cc h i e'
  have hPhi : Phi u cc h (Psi u cc h g) = g := by
    funext w
    rcases cases h w with e | e | ⟨i, e⟩
    · rw [e, Phi_u, hu]
    · rw [e, Phi_cc, hfix]
    · rw [e, Phi_E, hE]
  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, hPhi⟩
  · intro i
    apply E_inj h
    calc E u cc (Psi u cc h g (Psi u cc h g i)) = g (E u cc (Psi u cc h g i)) := hE _
      _ = g (g (E u cc i)) := by rw [hE i]
      _ = g (E u cc i) := hI _
      _ = E u cc (Psi u cc h g i) := (hE i).symm
  · intro v hv hb
    have hb' := (badAt_Phi_E h (Psi u cc h g) v).mpr hb
    rw [hPhi] at hb'
    exact hB _ ((E_val_lt h v).mpr hv) hb'

name: A347722.StepD.U_lt
statement: theorem U_lt {m c : ℕ} (hc : c < m + 2) (j : Fin c) : U hc j < ⟨c, hc⟩
proof:
:=
  Fin.lt_def.mpr j.isLt

name: A347722.StepD.card_V
statement:
theorem card_V (m c : ℕ) (hc : c < m + 2) :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun g : Fin (m + 2) → Fin (m + 2) =>
      Idem g ∧ (∀ v : Fin (m + 2), v.val < c → ¬BadAt g v) ∧ BadAt g ⟨c, hc⟩).card
      = c * D m (c - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hprod : c * D m (c - 1) = ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin c)) ×ˢ
      (Finset.univ.filter fun g : Fin m → Fin m =>
        Idem g ∧ ∀ v : Fin m, v.val < c - 1 → ¬BadAt g v)).card := by
    rw [Finset.card_product, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]; rfl
  rw [hprod]
  symm
  refine Finset.card_bij (fun p _ => Phi (U hc p.1) ⟨c, hc⟩ (U_lt hc p.1) p.2) ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro p hp
    have h2 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.mem_product.mp hp).2).2
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, Phi_mem (U_lt hc p.1) p.2 h2.1 h2.2⟩
  · rintro ⟨j, g1⟩ - ⟨k, g2⟩ - heq
    have heq' : Phi (U hc j) ⟨c, hc⟩ (U_lt hc j) g1 = Phi (U hc k) ⟨c, hc⟩ (U_lt hc k) g2 := heq
    have hjk : j = k := by
      have h1 := congrFun heq' (U hc j)
      rw [Phi_u] at h1
      rcases Phi_eq_cc (U_lt hc k) g2 h1.symm with e | e
      · have e' : (U hc j).val = (U hc k).val := congrArg Fin.val e
        exact Fin.ext e'
      · exact absurd e (ne_of_lt (U_lt hc j))
    subst hjk
    have hg : g1 = g2 := by
      funext i
      have e1 := congrFun heq' (E (U hc j) ⟨c, hc⟩ i)
      rw [Phi_E, Phi_E] at e1
      exact E_inj (U_lt hc j) e1
    rw [hg]
  · intro g hg
    obtain ⟨hI, hB, hbad⟩ := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hg).2
    obtain ⟨u0, hu0, hgu0, -⟩ := hbad.2
    have hval : u0.val < c := Fin.lt_def.mp hu0
    have hU : U hc ⟨u0.val, hval⟩ = u0 := Fin.ext rfl
    have spec := Psi_spec (U_lt hc ⟨u0.val, hval⟩) g hI hB hbad (by rw [hU]; exact hgu0)
    exact ⟨(⟨u0.val, hval⟩, Psi (U hc ⟨u0.val, hval⟩) ⟨c, hc⟩ (U_lt hc _) g),
      Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _,
        Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, spec.1⟩⟩, spec.2⟩

name: A347722.StepD.D_split
statement:
theorem D_split (n c : ℕ) (hc : c < n) :
    D n c = D n (c + 1) + (Finset.univ.filter fun g : Fin n → Fin n =>
      Idem g ∧ (∀ v : Fin n, v.val < c → ¬BadAt g v) ∧ BadAt g ⟨c, hc⟩).card
proof:
:= by
  have key := Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not
    (s := Finset.univ.filter fun g : Fin n → Fin n => Idem g ∧ ∀ v : Fin n, v.val < c → ¬BadAt g v)
    (fun g => BadAt g ⟨c, hc⟩)
  rw [Finset.filter_filter, Finset.filter_filter] at key
  have e1 : (Finset.univ.filter fun g : Fin n → Fin n =>
      Idem g ∧ ∀ v : Fin n, v.val < c + 1 → ¬BadAt g v)
      = (Finset.univ.filter fun g : Fin n → Fin n =>
        (Idem g ∧ ∀ v : Fin n, v.val < c → ¬BadAt g v) ∧ ¬BadAt g ⟨c, hc⟩) := by
    apply Finset.filter_congr
    intro g _
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hI, hB⟩
      exact ⟨⟨hI, fun v hv => hB v (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hv)⟩, hB ⟨c, hc⟩ (Nat.lt_succ_self c)⟩
    · rintro ⟨⟨hI, hB⟩, hc'⟩
      refine ⟨hI, fun v hv => ?_⟩
      rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp hv with h1 | h1
      · exact hB v h1
      · have hv' : v = ⟨c, hc⟩ := Fin.ext h1
        rw [hv']; exact hc'
  have e2 : (Finset.univ.filter fun g : Fin n → Fin n =>
      Idem g ∧ (∀ v : Fin n, v.val < c → ¬BadAt g v) ∧ BadAt g ⟨c, hc⟩)
      = (Finset.univ.filter fun g : Fin n → Fin n =>
        (Idem g ∧ ∀ v : Fin n, v.val < c → ¬BadAt g v) ∧ BadAt g ⟨c, hc⟩) := by
    apply Finset.filter_congr
    intro g _
    exact and_assoc.symm
  unfold D
  rw [e1, e2, add_comm]
  exact key.symm

name: A347722.D_succ
statement: theorem D_succ (n c : ℕ) (hc : c < n) : D n (c + 1) + c * D (n - 2) (c - 1) = D n c
proof:
:= by
  rw [D_split n c hc]
  congr 1
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos c with rfl | hpos
  · rw [zero_mul]
    symm
    rw [Finset.card_eq_zero, Finset.filter_eq_empty_iff]
    rintro g - ⟨-, -, -, u, hu, -⟩
    exact absurd (Fin.lt_def.mp hu) (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  · obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, n = m + 2 := ⟨n - 2, by omega⟩
    rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    exact (card_V m c hc).symm

name: A347722.Matchings.deg_eq_one_iff
statement:
lemma deg_eq_one_iff {S : Finset (Finset (Fin n))} {v : Fin n} :
    deg S v = 1 ↔ ∃ e ∈ S, v ∈ e ∧ ∀ g ∈ S, v ∈ g → g = e
proof:
:= by
  unfold deg
  rw [card_eq_one]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨e, he⟩
    have h1 : e ∈ S.filter fun e => v ∈ e := by rw [he]; exact mem_singleton_self e
    rw [mem_filter] at h1
    refine ⟨e, h1.1, h1.2, fun g hg hvg => ?_⟩
    have h2 : g ∈ S.filter fun e => v ∈ e := mem_filter.2 ⟨hg, hvg⟩
    rw [he] at h2
    exact mem_singleton.1 h2
  · rintro ⟨e, heS, hve, huniq⟩
    refine ⟨e, ?_⟩
    ext g
    rw [mem_filter, mem_singleton]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hg, hvg⟩
      exact huniq g hg hvg
    · intro h
      rw [h]
      exact ⟨heS, hve⟩

name: A347722.Matchings.exists_pair
statement:
lemma exists_pair {e : Finset (Fin n)} {v : Fin n} (h : e.card = 2) (hv : v ∈ e) :
    ∃ p, p ≠ v ∧ e = {v, p}
proof:
:= by
  rw [card_eq_two] at h
  obtain ⟨x, y, hxy, rfl⟩ := h
  rw [mem_insert, mem_singleton] at hv
  rcases hv with h | h
  · rw [h]
    exact ⟨y, hxy.symm, rfl⟩
  · rw [h]
    exact ⟨x, hxy, pair_comm _ _⟩

name: A347722.Matchings.mem_pmOn
statement:
lemma mem_pmOn {A : Finset (Fin n)} {S : Finset (Finset (Fin n))} :
    S ∈ pmOn A ↔ (∀ e ∈ S, e ⊆ A ∧ e.card = 2) ∧
      ∀ w ∈ A, ∃ e ∈ S, w ∈ e ∧ ∀ g ∈ S, w ∈ g → g = e
proof:
:= by
  unfold pmOn
  rw [mem_filter, mem_powerset]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    exact ⟨fun e he => mem_powersetCard.1 (h1 he), fun w hw => deg_eq_one_iff.1 (h2 w hw)⟩
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    exact ⟨fun e he => mem_powersetCard.2 (h1 e he), fun w hw => deg_eq_one_iff.2 (h2 w hw)⟩

name: A347722.Matchings.notMem_of_mem_pmOn
statement:
lemma notMem_of_mem_pmOn {B : Finset (Fin n)} {S : Finset (Finset (Fin n))} (hS : S ∈ pmOn B)
    {g : Finset (Fin n)} (hg : g ∈ S) {x : Fin n} (hx : x ∉ B) : x ∉ g
proof:
:=
  fun h => hx (((mem_pmOn.1 hS).1 g hg).1 h)

name: A347722.Matchings.insert_mem_pmOn
statement:
lemma insert_mem_pmOn {A : Finset (Fin n)} {v p : Fin n} (hv : v ∈ A) (hp : p ∈ A.erase v)
    {S' : Finset (Finset (Fin n))} (hS : S' ∈ pmOn ((A.erase v).erase p)) :
    insert {v, p} S' ∈ pmOn A
proof:
:= by
  have hpv : p ≠ v := ne_of_mem_erase hp
  have hpA : p ∈ A := mem_of_mem_erase hp
  have hvB : v ∉ (A.erase v).erase p := fun h => notMem_erase v A (mem_of_mem_erase h)
  have hpB : p ∉ (A.erase v).erase p := notMem_erase p _
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := mem_pmOn.1 hS
  rw [mem_pmOn]
  constructor
  · intro e he
    rcases mem_insert.1 he with rfl | he
    · refine ⟨?_, card_pair hpv.symm⟩
      intro x hx
      rcases mem_insert.1 hx with h | h
      · rw [h]; exact hv
      · rw [mem_singleton.1 h]; exact hpA
    · exact ⟨(h1 e he).1.trans ((erase_subset _ _).trans (erase_subset _ _)), (h1 e he).2⟩
  · intro w hw
    by_cases hwv : w = v
    · refine ⟨{v, p}, mem_insert_self _ _, by rw [hwv]; exact mem_insert_self _ _,
        fun g hg hwg => ?_⟩
      rcases mem_insert.1 hg with h | h
      · exact h
      · rw [hwv] at hwg
        exact absurd hwg (notMem_of_mem_pmOn hS h hvB)
    by_cases hwp : w = p
    · refine ⟨{v, p}, mem_insert_self _ _, by rw [hwp]; simp, fun g hg hwg => ?_⟩
      rcases mem_insert.1 hg with h | h
      · exact h
      · rw [hwp] at hwg
        exact absurd hwg (notMem_of_mem_pmOn hS h hpB)
    · have hwB : w ∈ (A.erase v).erase p := mem_erase.2 ⟨hwp, mem_erase.2 ⟨hwv, hw⟩⟩
      obtain ⟨e, he, hwe, hu⟩ := h2 w hwB
      refine ⟨e, mem_insert_of_mem he, hwe, fun g hg hwg => ?_⟩
      rcases mem_insert.1 hg with h | h
      · rw [h, mem_insert, mem_singleton] at hwg
        rcases hwg with h' | h'
        · exact absurd h' hwv
        · exact absurd h' hwp
      · exact hu g h hwg

name: A347722.Matchings.erase_mem_pmOn
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := mem_pmOn.1 hS
  have hvp : ∀ g ∈ S, v ∈ g → g = {v, p} := by
    intro g hg hvg
    obtain ⟨e, _, _, hu⟩ := h2 v hv
    exact (hu g hg hvg).trans (hu _ he (mem_insert_self _ _)).symm
  have hpp : ∀ g ∈ S, p ∈ g → g = {v, p} := by
    intro g hg hpg
    obtain ⟨e, _, _, hu⟩ := h2 p hpA
    exact (hu g hg hpg).trans (hu _ he (by simp)).symm
  rw [mem_pmOn]
  constructor
  · intro g hg
    obtain ⟨hne, hgS⟩ := mem_erase.1 hg
    refine ⟨fun x hx => ?_, (h1 g hgS).2⟩
    refine mem_erase.2 ⟨?_, mem_erase.2 ⟨?_, (h1 g hgS).1 hx⟩⟩
    · intro h
      rw [h] at hx
      exact hne (hpp g hgS hx)
    · intro h
      rw [h] at hx
      exact hne (hvp g hgS hx)
  · intro w hw
    obtain ⟨hwp, hw'⟩ := mem_erase.1 hw
    obtain ⟨hwv, hwA⟩ := mem_erase.1 hw'
    obtain ⟨e, heS, hwe, hu⟩ := h2 w hwA
    refine ⟨e, mem_erase.2 ⟨?_, heS⟩, hwe, fun g hg hwg => hu g (mem_of_mem_erase hg) hwg⟩
    intro h
    rw [h, mem_insert, mem_singleton] at hwe
    rcases hwe with h' | h'
    · exact hwv h'
    · exact hwp h'

name: A347722.Matchings.pmOn_eq_biUnion
statement:
lemma pmOn_eq_biUnion {A : Finset (Fin n)} {v : Fin n} (hv : v ∈ A) :
    pmOn A = (A.erase v).biUnion fun p =>
      (pmOn ((A.erase v).erase p)).image (insert {v, p})
proof:
:= by
  ext S
  rw [mem_biUnion]
  constructor
  · intro hS
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := mem_pmOn.1 hS
    obtain ⟨e, heS, hve, -⟩ := h2 v hv
    obtain ⟨p, hpv, rfl⟩ := exists_pair (h1 e heS).2 hve
    have hpA : p ∈ A := (h1 _ heS).1 (by simp)
    exact ⟨p, mem_erase.2 ⟨hpv, hpA⟩,
      mem_image.2 ⟨_, erase_mem_pmOn hS hv hpA heS, insert_erase heS⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨p, hp, hS⟩
    obtain ⟨S', hS', rfl⟩ := mem_image.1 hS
    exact insert_mem_pmOn hv hp hS'

name: A347722.Matchings.card_pmOn_rec
statement:
lemma card_pmOn_rec {A : Finset (Fin n)} {v : Fin n} (hv : v ∈ A) :
    (pmOn A).card = ∑ p ∈ A.erase v, (pmOn ((A.erase v).erase p)).card
proof:
:= by
  have hvB : ∀ p, v ∉ (A.erase v).erase p := fun p h => notMem_erase v A (mem_of_mem_erase h)
  rw [pmOn_eq_biUnion hv, card_biUnion]
  · refine sum_congr rfl fun p hp => card_image_of_injOn ?_
    intro S hS T hT hST
    have h1 : ({v, p} : Finset (Fin n)) ∉ S :=
      fun h => notMem_of_mem_pmOn (mem_coe.1 hS) h (hvB p) (mem_insert_self _ _)
    have h2 : ({v, p} : Finset (Fin n)) ∉ T :=
      fun h => notMem_of_mem_pmOn (mem_coe.1 hT) h (hvB p) (mem_insert_self _ _)
    have hST' : insert {v, p} S = insert {v, p} T := hST
    calc S = (insert {v, p} S).erase {v, p} := (erase_insert h1).symm
      _ = (insert {v, p} T).erase {v, p} := by rw [hST']
      _ = T := erase_insert h2
  · intro p hp q hq hpq
    rw [Function.onFun, disjoint_left]
    intro S hSp hSq
    obtain ⟨S', hS', rfl⟩ := mem_image.1 hSp
    obtain ⟨T', hT', hT⟩ := mem_image.1 hSq
    have hmem : ({v, p} : Finset (Fin n)) ∈ insert {v, q} T' := by
      rw [hT]; exact mem_insert_self _ _
    rcases mem_insert.1 hmem with h | h
    · have hp' : p ∈ ({v, q} : Finset (Fin n)) := by rw [← h]; simp
      rw [mem_insert, mem_singleton] at hp'
      rcases hp' with h' | h'
      · exact ne_of_mem_erase (mem_coe.1 hp) h'
      · exact hpq h'
    · exact notMem_of_mem_pmOn hT' h (hvB q) (mem_insert_self _ _)

name: A347722.Matchings.pmOn_empty
statement: lemma pmOn_empty : pmOn (∅ : Finset (Fin n)) = {∅}
proof:
:= by
  ext S
  rw [mem_pmOn, mem_singleton]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h1, -⟩
    refine eq_empty_of_forall_notMem fun e he => ?_
    obtain ⟨h3, h4⟩ := h1 e he
    rw [subset_empty.1 h3, card_empty] at h4
    exact absurd h4 (by decide)
  · intro h
    rw [h]
    exact ⟨fun e he => absurd he (notMem_empty e), fun w hw => absurd hw (notMem_empty w)⟩

name: A347722.Matchings.card_pmOn
statement:
lemma card_pmOn : ∀ (k : ℕ) (A : Finset (Fin n)), A.card = k →
    (pmOn A).card = if Even k then Nat.doubleFactorial (k - 1) else 0
proof:
:= by
  intro k
  induction k using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h k ih =>
    intro A hA
    rcases k with _ | _ | m
    · rw [card_eq_zero.1 hA, pmOn_empty]
      simp
    · obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ : A.Nonempty := card_pos.1 (by omega)
      have h0 : A.erase v = ∅ := card_eq_zero.1 (by rw [card_erase_of_mem hv, hA])
      rw [card_pmOn_rec hv, h0]
      simp
    · obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ : A.Nonempty := card_pos.1 (by omega)
      have h : ∀ p ∈ A.erase v, (pmOn ((A.erase v).erase p)).card =
          if Even m then Nat.doubleFactorial (m - 1) else 0 := fun p hp =>
        ih m (by omega) _ (by
          have h3 := card_erase_of_mem hp
          have h4 := card_erase_of_mem hv
          omega)
      have he : Even (m + 1 + 1) ↔ Even m := by
        rw [add_assoc, Nat.even_add]
        simp
      rw [card_pmOn_rec hv, sum_const_nat h, card_erase_of_mem hv, hA]
      simp only [he]
      split_ifs with hm
      · cases m with
        | zero => rfl
        | succ j => exact (Nat.doubleFactorial_add_two j).symm
      · exact Nat.mul_zero _

name: A347722.card_pms
statement:
theorem card_pms (n : ℕ) :
    ((verts n).powerset.filter PM).card = if Even n then Nat.doubleFactorial (n - 1) else 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : (verts n).powerset.filter PM = Matchings.pmOn (univ : Finset (Fin n)) := by
    unfold Matchings.pmOn verts
    exact filter_congr fun S _ => by simp [PM]
  rw [h]
  exact Matchings.card_pmOn n univ (by simp)

name: A347722.Closed.mu_zero
statement: theorem mu_zero (c : ℕ) : mu c 0 = 1
proof: := by simp [mu]

name: A347722.Closed.mu_eq_zero
statement: theorem mu_eq_zero {c j : ℕ} (hcj : c < 2 * j) : mu c j = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [mu, Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt hcj]

name: A347722.Closed.mu_succ
statement: theorem mu_succ (c j : ℕ) : mu (c + 1) (j + 1) = mu c (j + 1) + c * mu (c - 1) j
proof:
:= by
  have e1 : 2 * (j + 1) = 2 * j + 1 + 1 := by ring
  have e2 : 2 * (j + 1) - 1 = 2 * j + 1 := by omega
  have hk : (c.choose (2 * j + 1) : ℤ) * (2 * j + 1) = c * ((c - 1).choose (2 * j) : ℤ) := by
    cases c with
    | zero => simp
    | succ c =>
      have := Nat.add_one_mul_choose_eq c (2 * j)
      simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel]
      exact_mod_cast this.symm
  have hd : (Nat.doubleFactorial (2 * j + 1) : ℤ)
      = (2 * j + 1) * (Nat.doubleFactorial (2 * j - 1) : ℤ) := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.doubleFactorial_add_one (2 * j)
  unfold mu
  rw [e2, e1, Nat.choose_succ_succ, hd]
  push_cast
  linear_combination (Nat.doubleFactorial (2 * j - 1) : ℤ) * hk

name: A347722.Closed.T_succ
statement:
theorem T_succ (c n M : ℕ) :
    T (c + 1) n (M + 1) = T c n (M + 1) - c * T (c - 1) (n - 2) M
proof:
:= by
  unfold T
  rw [sum_range_succ', sum_range_succ', mul_sum]
  simp only [mu_zero]
  have : ∑ j ∈ range M, (-1 : ℤ) ^ (j + 1) * mu (c + 1) (j + 1) * (h (n - 2 * (j + 1)) : ℤ)
      = ∑ j ∈ range M, (-1 : ℤ) ^ (j + 1) * mu c (j + 1) * (h (n - 2 * (j + 1)) : ℤ)
        - ∑ j ∈ range M, (c : ℤ) * ((-1) ^ j * mu (c - 1) j * (h (n - 2 - 2 * j) : ℤ)) := by
    rw [← sum_sub_distrib]
    refine sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    have e : n - 2 - 2 * j = n - 2 * (j + 1) := by omega
    rw [e, mu_succ]
    ring
  linarith

name: A347722.Closed.D_eq
statement:
theorem D_eq (D' : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ)
    (hD0 : ∀ n, D' n 0 = h n)
    (hDs : ∀ n c, c < n → D' n (c + 1) + c * D' (n - 2) (c - 1) = D' n c) :
    ∀ c n N, c ≤ n → c < 2 * N → (D' n c : ℤ) = T c n N
proof:
:= by
  intro c
  induction c using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ c ih =>
    intro n N hcn hcN
    cases c with
    | zero =>
      obtain ⟨M, rfl⟩ : ∃ M, N = M + 1 := ⟨N - 1, by omega⟩
      unfold T
      rw [sum_range_succ', sum_eq_zero, hD0]
      · simp [mu_zero]
      · intro j _
        rw [mu_eq_zero (by omega)]
        ring
    | succ c =>
      obtain ⟨M, rfl⟩ : ∃ M, N = M + 1 := ⟨N - 1, by omega⟩
      have h1 : (D' n (c + 1) : ℤ) + c * (D' (n - 2) (c - 1) : ℤ) = D' n c := by
        exact_mod_cast hDs n c (by omega)
      have h2 : (D' n c : ℤ) = T c n (M + 1) := ih c (by omega) n (M + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
      have h3 : (c : ℤ) * (D' (n - 2) (c - 1) : ℤ) = c * T (c - 1) (n - 2) M := by
        cases c with
        | zero => simp
        | succ c =>
          rw [ih (c + 1 - 1) (by omega) (n - 2) M (by omega) (by omega)]
      rw [T_succ]
      linarith

name: A347722.Closed.T_self
statement: theorem T_self (n : ℕ) : T n n (n / 2 + 1) = f n
proof:
:= by
  unfold T f
  refine sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  unfold mu
  ring

name: A347722.Closed.F_eq
statement:
theorem F_eq (D' F' : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ)
    (hDf : ∀ n, (D' n n : ℤ) = f n)
    (hF0 : ∀ n, F' n 0 = D' n n)
    (hFs : ∀ n d, d ≤ n → F' (n + 1) (d + 1) + F' n d = F' (n + 1) d) :
    ∀ d n, d ≤ n →
